752	
753	## 2. Anatomy
754	
755	```text
756	ColorField
757	├── Root             (<div>)        (required)
758	├── Label            (<label>)      (required)
759	├── Input            (<input>)      (required — type="text")
760	├── Description      (<div>)        (optional)
761	├── ErrorMessage     (<div>)        (optional — role="alert")
762	└── HiddenInput      (<input>)      (required — type="hidden", submits hex)
763	```
764	
765	| Part         | Element   | Key Attributes                                                                        |
766	| ------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
767	| Root         | `<div>`   | `data-ars-disabled`, `data-ars-readonly`, `data-ars-invalid`, `data-ars-focused`      |
768	| Label        | `<label>` | `for` pointing to Input                                                               |
769	| Input        | `<input>` | `type="text"`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required`, `aria-describedby` |
770	| Description  | `<div>`   | Referenced by Input `aria-describedby`                                                |
771	| ErrorMessage | `<div>`   | `role="alert"`, referenced by Input `aria-describedby`                                |
772	| HiddenInput  | `<input>` | `type="hidden"`, `name`, `value` (hex)                                                |
773	
774	## 3. Accessibility
775	
776	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
777	
778	| Attribute / Behaviour             | Element                  | Value                                          |
779	| --------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
780	| `role="spinbutton"`               | Input (channel mode)     | ARIA spinbutton pattern                        |
781	| `inputmode="numeric"`             | Input (channel mode)     | Numeric keyboard on mobile                     |
782	| `inputmode="text"`                | Input (whole-color mode) | Text keyboard on mobile                        |
783	| `aria-valuenow`                   | Input (channel mode)     | Current channel value                          |
784	| `aria-valuemin` / `aria-valuemax` | Input (channel mode)     | From `channel_range(channel)`                  |
785	| `aria-valuetext`                  | Input (channel mode)     | Localized formatted channel value              |
786	| `aria-label`                      | Input (channel mode)     | Channel name (from messages)                   |
787	| `aria-labelledby`                 | Input                    | Label element ID                               |
788	| `aria-invalid`                    | Input                    | `"true"` when parse failed or external invalid |
789	| `aria-required`                   | Input                    | `"true"` when required                         |
790	| `aria-readonly`                   | Input                    | When read-only                                 |
791	| `aria-disabled` / `disabled`      | Input                    | When disabled                                  |
792	| `aria-describedby`                | Input                    | Description + ErrorMessage IDs                 |
793	| `role="alert"`                    | ErrorMessage             | Live error announcement                        |
794	
795	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
796	
797	| Key       | Context              | Action                  |
798	| --------- | -------------------- | ----------------------- |
799	| Enter     | Input                | Commit (parse value)    |
800	| ArrowUp   | Input (channel mode) | Increment by step       |
801	| ArrowDown | Input (channel mode) | Decrement by step       |
802	| PageUp    | Input (channel mode) | Increment by large_step |
803	| PageDown  | Input (channel mode) | Decrement by large_step |
804	| Home      | Input (channel mode) | Set to min              |
805	| End       | Input (channel mode) | Set to max              |
806	
807	IME: All keyboard shortcuts are suppressed while `is_composing` is true.
808	
809	## 4. Internationalization
810	
811	### 4.1 Messages
812	
813	```rust
814	/// The messages for the `ColorField` component.
815	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
816	pub struct Messages {
817	    /// Label for a channel input. Default: channel name (e.g., `"Hue"`).
818	    pub channel_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(ColorChannel, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
819	    /// Formatted channel value for aria-valuetext.
820	    pub channel_value_text: MessageFn<dyn Fn(ColorChannel, f64, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
821	    /// Label for whole-color mode. Default: `"Color value"`.
822	    pub color_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
823	    /// Message shown when parsing fails. Default: `"Invalid color value"`.
824	    pub invalid_message: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
825	}
826	
827	impl Default for Messages {
828	    fn default() -> Self {
829	        Self {
830	            channel_label: MessageFn::new(|ch, _locale| format!("{ch:?}")),
831	            channel_value_text: MessageFn::new(|ch, val, _locale| match ch {
832	                ColorChannel::Hue => format!("{val:.0}°"),
833	                ColorChannel::Red | ColorChannel::Green | ColorChannel::Blue => format!("{val:.0}"),
834	                _ => format!("{:.0}%", val * 100.0),
835	            }),
836	            color_label: MessageFn::static_str("Color value"),
837	            invalid_message: MessageFn::static_str("Invalid color value"),
838	        }
839	    }
840	}
841	
842	impl ComponentMessages for Messages {}
843	```
844	
845	| Key                              | Default (en-US)                              | Purpose                         |
846	| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
847	| `color_field.channel_label`      | Channel name (e.g., `"Hue"`)                 | Channel-mode `aria-label`       |
848	| `color_field.channel_value_text` | Channel-specific formatting (e.g., `"180°"`) | Channel-mode `aria-valuetext`   |
849	| `color_field.color_label`        | `"Color value"`                              | Whole-color mode label fallback |
850	| `color_field.invalid_message`    | `"Invalid color value"`                      | Error message text              |
851	
852	- **Color format strings** (hex/rgb/hsl CSS syntax) are locale-independent.
853	- **Channel `aria-valuetext`** uses localized number formatting via message closures.
854	- **RTL**: No special layout handling needed (single text input).
855	
856	## 5. Library Parity
857	
858	> Compared against: Ark UI (`ColorPicker.ChannelInput`), React Aria (`ColorField`).

  "content": "//! `ColorField` component state machine and connect API.\n//!\n//! `ColorField` is a text input for color values. ctx.input_text.trim().parse::<f64>() {\n                Ok(raw) => {\n                    let (min, max) = channel_range(ch);\n                    let clamped = raw.clamp(min, max);\n }\n}\n\n/// Adjust the channel value by `delta` (positive or negative), clamped to range.\nfn adjust_channel(ctx: &mut Context, delta: f64) {\n    if let (Some(ch), Some(color)) = (ctx.channel, ctx.value.get()) {\n        let current = channel_value(color, ch);\n        let (min, max) = channel_range(ch);\n        let new_val = (current + delta).clamp(min, max);\n        let new_color = with_channel(color, ch, new_val);\n        ctx.value.set(Some(new_color));\n        ctx.input_text = format_value(&new_color, ctx.channel, ctx.color_format);\n        ctx.invalid = false;\n    }\n}\n\n/// Snap the channel to `min` or `max` and refresh the input text.\nfn snap_channel(ctx: &mut Context, to_max: bool) {\n    if let (Some(ch), Some(color)) = (ctx.channel, ctx.value.get()) {\n        let (min, max) = channel_range(ch);\n        let target = if to_max { max } else { min };\n        let new_color = with_channel(color, ch, target);\n        ctx.value.set(Some(new_color));\n        ctx.input_text = format_value(&new_color, ctx.channel, ctx.color_format);\n        ctx.invalid = false;\n    }\n}\n\n/// The machine for the `ColorField` component.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct Machine;\n\nimpl ars_core::Machine for Machine {\n    type State = State;\n    type Event = Event;\n    type Context = Context;\n    type Props = Props;\n    type Messages = Messages;\n    type Effect = NoEffect;\n    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;\n\n    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {\n        let value = match &props.value {\n has_description: false,\n            name: props.name.clone(),\n            locale: env.locale.clone(),\n            messages: messages.clone(),\n            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),\n 156	```rust
157	/// Apply normalized (x, y) coordinates to both channels.
158	fn apply_area_position(ctx: &mut Context, x: f64, y: f64) {
159	    let color = ctx.value.get();
160	    let (x_min, x_max) = channel_range(ctx.x_channel);
161	    let (y_min, y_max) = channel_range(ctx.y_channel);
162	    let x_val = x_min + x.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * (x_max - x_min);
163	    // y is inverted: top=max, bottom=min
164	    let y_val = y_max - y.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * (y_max - y_min);
165	    let updated = with_channel(color, ctx.x_channel, x_val);
166	    ctx.value.set(with_channel(&updated, ctx.y_channel, y_val));
167	}
168	
169	pub struct Machine;
170	
171	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
172	    type State = State;
173	    type Event = Event;
174	    type Context = Context;
175	    type Props = Props;
176	    type Messages = Messages;
177	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
178	
179	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
180	        let value = match &props.value {
181	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
182	            None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
183	        };
184	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
185	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
186	        let messages = messages.clone();
187	
188	        (State::Idle, Context {
189	            value,
190	            x_channel: props.x_channel,
191	            y_channel: props.y_channel,
192	            disabled: props.disabled,
193	            readonly: props.readonly,
194	            focused: false,
195	            focus_visible: false,
196	            step: props.step,
197	            large_step: props.large_step,
198	            dir: props.dir,
199	            locale,
200	            messages,
201	            ids,
202	        })
203	    }
204	
205	    fn transition(
206	        state: &Self::State,
207	        event: &Self::Event,
208	        ctx: &Self::Context,
209	        _props: &Self::Props,
210	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
211	        if ctx.disabled {
212	            return match event {
213	                Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
214	                    let kb = *is_keyboard;
215	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
216	                        ctx.focused = true;
217	                        ctx.focus_visible = kb;
218	                    }))
219	                }
220	                Event::Blur => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
221	                    ctx.focused = false;
222	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
223	                })),
224	                _ => None,
225	            };
226	        }
227	
228	        match (state, event) {
229	            (State::Idle, Event::DragStart { x, y }) => {
230	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
231	                let x = *x;
232	                let y = *y;
233	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Dragging).apply(move |ctx| {
234	                    apply_area_position(ctx, x, y);
235	                }).with_named_effect("drag-listeners", move |_ctx, _props, send| {
236	                    let platform = use_platform_effects();
237	                    let send_move = send.clone();
238	                    let send_up = send.clone();
239	                    platform.track_pointer_drag(
240	                        Box::new(move |x, y| { send_move.call_if_alive(Event::DragMove { x, y }); }),
241	                        Box::new(move || { send_up.call_if_alive(Event::DragEnd); }),
242	                    )
243	                }))
244	            }
245	
246	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragMove { x, y }) => {
247	                let x = *x;
248	                let y = *y;
249	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
250	                    apply_area_position(ctx, x, y);
251	                }))
252	            }
253	
254	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragEnd) => {
255	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle))
256	            }
257	
258	            (_, Event::IncrementX { step }) => {
259	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
260	                let step = *step;
261	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
262	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
263	                    let current = channel_value(color, ctx.x_channel);
264	                    let (_, max) = channel_range(ctx.x_channel);
265	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.x_channel, (current + step).min(max)));
266	                }))
267	            }
268	
269	            (_, Event::DecrementX { step }) => {
270	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
271	                let step = *step;
272	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
273	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
274	                    let current = channel_value(color, ctx.x_channel);
275	                    let (min, _) = channel_range(ctx.x_channel);
276	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.x_channel, (current - step).max(min)));
277	                }))
278	            }
279	
280	            (_, Event::IncrementY { step }) => {
281	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
282	                let step = *step;
283	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
284	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
285	                    let current = channel_value(color, ctx.y_channel);
286	                    let (_, max) = channel_range(ctx.y_channel);
287	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.y_channel, (current + step).min(max)));
288	                }))
289	            }
290	
291	            (_, Event::DecrementY { step }) => {
292	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
293	                let step = *step;
294	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
295	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
296	                    let current = channel_value(color, ctx.y_channel);
297	                    let (min, _) = channel_range(ctx.y_channel);
298	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.y_channel, (current - step).max(min)));
299	                }))
300	            }
301	
302	            (_, Event::SetXToMin) => {
303	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
304	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
305	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
306	                    let (min, _) = channel_range(ctx.x_channel);

371	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
372	#[scope = "color-area"]
373	pub enum Part {
374	    Root,
375	    Background,
376	    Thumb,
377	    HiddenInput,
378	}
379	
380	pub struct Api<'a> {
381	    state: &'a State,
382	    ctx: &'a Context,
383	    props: &'a Props,
384	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
385	}
386	
387	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
388	    pub fn is_dragging(&self) -> bool { matches!(self.state, State::Dragging) }
389	    pub fn value(&self) -> &ColorValue { self.ctx.value.get() }
390	
391	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
392	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
393	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
394	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
395	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
396	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "group");
397	        if self.ctx.disabled {
398	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true);
399	        }
400	        if self.ctx.readonly {
401	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-readonly"), true);
402	        }
403	        if self.is_dragging() {
404	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-dragging"), true);
405	        }
406	        attrs
407	    }
408	
409	    pub fn background_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
410	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
411	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Background.data_attrs();
412	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
413	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
414	        let color = self.ctx.value.get();
415	        let bg = format!("hsl({:.0}, 100%, 50%)", color.hue);
416	        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::Custom("ars-color-area-bg"), bg);
417	        attrs
418	    }
419	
420	    pub fn thumb_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
421	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
422	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Thumb.data_attrs();
423	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
424	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
425	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("thumb"));
426	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "application");
427	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::RoleDescription), (self.ctx.messages.role_description)(&self.ctx.locale));
428	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "0");
429	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), (self.ctx.messages.label)(&self.ctx.locale));
430	
431	        let color = self.ctx.value.get();
432	        let x_val = channel_value(color, self.ctx.x_channel);
433	        let y_val = channel_value(color, self.ctx.y_channel);
434	        let (x_min, x_max) = channel_range(self.ctx.x_channel);
435	        let (y_min, y_max) = channel_range(self.ctx.y_channel);
436	
437	        let x_name = format!("{:?}", self.ctx.x_channel).to_lowercase();
438	        let y_name = format!("{:?}", self.ctx.y_channel).to_lowercase();
439	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueText),
440	            (self.ctx.messages.value_text)(x_val, y_val, &x_name, &y_name, &self.ctx.locale));
441	
442	        let x_pct = if (x_max - x_min).abs() > f64::EPSILON {
443	            (x_val - x_min) / (x_max - x_min) * 100.0
444	        } else { 0.0 };
445	        let y_pct = if (y_max - y_min).abs() > f64::EPSILON {
446	            (1.0 - (y_val - y_min) / (y_max - y_min)) * 100.0
447	        } else { 0.0 };
448	        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::Custom("ars-color-area-thumb-x"), format!("{:.1}%", x_pct));
449	        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::Custom("ars-color-area-thumb-y"), format!("{:.1}%", y_pct));
450	        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::BackgroundColor, color.to_css_hsl());
451	
452	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::KeyShortcuts), "ArrowUp ArrowDown ArrowLeft ArrowRight");
453	        if self.is_dragging() {
454	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-dragging"), true);
455	        }
456	        if self.ctx.focus_visible {
457	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true);
458	        }
459	        attrs
460	    }
461	
462	    pub fn hidden_input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
463	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
464	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::HiddenInput.data_attrs();
465	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
466	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
467	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden");
468	        if let Some(ref name) = self.props.name {
469	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name);
470	        }
471	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, self.ctx.value.get().to_hex(true));
472	        attrs
473	    }
474	
475	    pub fn on_thumb_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData, shift: bool) {
476	        let step = if shift { self.ctx.large_step } else { self.ctx.step };
477	        match data.key {
478	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight => (self.send)(Event::IncrementX { step }),
479	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => (self.send)(Event::DecrementX { step }),
480	            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => (self.send)(Event::IncrementY { step }),
481	            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => (self.send)(Event::DecrementY { step }),
482	            KeyboardKey::Home => (self.send)(Event::SetXToMin),
483	            KeyboardKey::End => (self.send)(Event::SetXToMax),
484	            KeyboardKey::PageUp => (self.send)(Event::SetYToMax),
485	            KeyboardKey::PageDown => (self.send)(Event::SetYToMin),
486	            _ => {}
487	        }
488	    }
489	
490	    pub fn on_background_pointer_down(&self, x: f64, y: f64) {
491	        (self.send)(Event::DragStart { x, y });
492	    }
493	}
494	
495	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
496	    type Part = Part;
497	
498	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
499	        match part {
500	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
501	            Part::Background => self.background_attrs(),
502	            Part::Thumb => self.thumb_attrs(),
503	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
504	        }
505	    }
506	}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Messages {
    /// Label for the area thumb. Default: `"Color area"`.
    pub label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
    /// Role description for screen readers. Default: `"2d color picker"`.
    pub role_description: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
    /// Formats both channel values for aria-valuetext.
    pub value_text: MessageFn<dyn Fn(f64, f64, &str, &str, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
}

impl Default for Messages {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            label: MessageFn::static_str("Color area"),
            role_description: MessageFn::static_str("2d color picker"),
            value_text: MessageFn::new(|x, y, x_name, y_name, _locale| {
                format!("{} {:.0}%, {} {:.0}%", x_name, x * 100.0, y_name, y * 100.0)
            }),
        }
    }
}

impl ComponentMessages for Messages {}

147	```rust
148	/// Apply a normalized position (0..1) to the channel value.
149	fn apply_slider_position(ctx: &mut Context, position: f64) {
150	    let color = ctx.value.get();
151	    let (min, max) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
152	    let value = min + position.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * (max - min);
153	    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.channel, value));
154	}
155	
156	pub struct Machine;
157	
158	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
159	    type State = State;
160	    type Event = Event;
161	    type Context = Context;
162	    type Props = Props;
163	    type Messages = Messages;
164	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
165	
166	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
167	        let value = match &props.value {
168	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
169	            None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
170	        };
171	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
172	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
173	        let messages = messages.clone();
174	
175	        (State::Idle, Context {
176	            value,
177	            channel: props.channel,
178	            orientation: props.orientation,
179	            disabled: props.disabled,
180	            readonly: props.readonly,
181	            focused: false,
182	            focus_visible: false,
183	            step: props.step,
184	            large_step: props.large_step,
185	            dir: props.dir,
186	            locale,
187	            messages,
188	            ids,
189	        })
190	    }
191	
192	    fn transition(
193	        state: &Self::State,
194	        event: &Self::Event,
195	        ctx: &Self::Context,
196	        _props: &Self::Props,
197	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
198	        if ctx.disabled {
199	            return match event {
200	                Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
201	                    let kb = *is_keyboard;
202	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
203	                        ctx.focused = true;
204	                        ctx.focus_visible = kb;
205	                    }))
206	                }
207	                Event::Blur => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
208	                    ctx.focused = false;
209	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
210	                })),
211	                _ => None,
212	            };
213	        }
214	
215	        match (state, event) {
216	            (State::Idle, Event::DragStart { position }) => {
217	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
218	                let pos = *position;
219	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Dragging).apply(move |ctx| {
220	                    apply_slider_position(ctx, pos);
221	                }).with_named_effect("drag-listeners", move |_ctx, _props, send| {
222	                    let platform = use_platform_effects();
223	                    let send_move = send.clone();
224	                    let send_up = send.clone();
225	                    platform.track_pointer_drag(
226	                        Box::new(move |x, y| { send_move.call_if_alive(Event::DragMove { position: x }); }),
227	                        Box::new(move || { send_up.call_if_alive(Event::DragEnd); }),
228	                    )
229	                }))
230	            }
231	
232	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragMove { position }) => {
233	                let pos = *position;
234	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
235	                    apply_slider_position(ctx, pos);
236	                }))
237	            }
238	
239	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragEnd) => {
240	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle))
241	            }
242	
243	            (_, Event::Increment { step }) => {
244	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
245	                let step = *step;
246	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
247	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
248	                    let current = channel_value(color, ctx.channel);
249	                    let (_, max) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
250	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.channel, (current + step).min(max)));
251	                }))
252	            }
253	
254	            (_, Event::Decrement { step }) => {
255	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
256	                let step = *step;
257	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
258	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
259	                    let current = channel_value(color, ctx.channel);
260	                    let (min, _) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
261	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.channel, (current - step).max(min)));
262	                }))
263	            }
264	
265	            (_, Event::SetToMin) => {
266	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
267	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
268	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
269	                    let (min, _) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
270	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.channel, min));
271	                }))
272	            }
273	
274	            (_, Event::SetToMax) => {
275	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
276	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
277	                    let color = ctx.value.get();
278	                    let (_, max) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
279	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(color, ctx.channel, max));
280	                }))
281	            }
282	
283	            (_, Event::Focus { is_keyboard }) => {
284	                let kb = *is_keyboard;
285	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
286	                    ctx.focused = true;
287	                    ctx.focus_visible = kb;
288	                }))
289	            }
290	
291	            (_, Event::Blur) => {
292	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
293	                    ctx.focused = false;
294	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
295	                }))
296	            }
297	
298	            _ => None,
299	        }
300	    }

316	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
317	#[scope = "color-slider"]
318	pub enum Part {
319	    Root,
320	    Label,
321	    Track,
322	    Thumb,
323	    Output,
324	    HiddenInput,
325	}
326	
327	pub struct Api<'a> {
328	    state: &'a State,
329	    ctx: &'a Context,
330	    props: &'a Props,
331	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
332	}
333	
334	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
335	    pub fn is_dragging(&self) -> bool { matches!(self.state, State::Dragging) }
336	    pub fn value(&self) -> &ColorValue { self.ctx.value.get() }
337	
338	    /// Current channel value formatted for display.
339	    pub fn formatted_value(&self) -> String {
340	        let color = self.ctx.value.get();
341	        let val = channel_value(color, self.ctx.channel);
342	        match self.ctx.channel {
343	            ColorChannel::Hue => format!("{:.0}°", val),
344	            ColorChannel::Red | ColorChannel::Green | ColorChannel::Blue => format!("{:.0}", val),
345	            _ => format!("{:.0}%", val * 100.0),
346	        }
347	    }
348

456	        match data.key {
457	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => (self.send)(Event::Increment { step }),
458	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft | KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => (self.send)(Event::Decrement { step }),
459	            KeyboardKey::Home => (self.send)(Event::SetToMin),
460	            KeyboardKey::End => (self.send)(Event::SetToMax),
461	            KeyboardKey::PageUp => (self.send)(Event::Increment { step: self.ctx.large_step }),
462	            KeyboardKey::PageDown => (self.send)(Event::Decrement { step: self.ctx.large_step }),
463	            _ => {}
464	        }
465	    }

165	/// Apply a normalized angle (0..1) to the hue value.
166	fn apply_wheel_angle(ctx: &mut Context, angle: f64) {
167	    let hue = (angle.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 360.0) % 360.0;
168	    let color = ctx.value.get().clone();
169	    ctx.value.set(ColorValue { hue, ..color });
170	}

172	/// The machine for the `ColorWheel` component.
173	pub struct Machine;
174	
175	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
176	    type State = State;
177	    type Event = Event;
178	    type Context = Context;
179	    type Props = Props;
180	    type Messages = Messages;
181	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
182	
183	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
184	        let value = match &props.value {
185	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
186	            None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
187	        };
188	
189	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
190	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
191	        let messages = messages.clone();
192	
193	        (State::Idle, Context {
194	            value,
195	            disabled: props.disabled,
196	            readonly: props.readonly,
197	            focused: false,
198	            focus_visible: false,
199	            step: props.step,
200	            large_step: props.large_step,
201	            dir: props.dir,
202	            locale,
203	            messages,
204	            ids,
205	        })
206	    }
207	
208	    fn transition(
209	        state: &Self::State,
210	        event: &Self::Event,
211	        ctx: &Self::Context,
212	        _props: &Self::Props,
213	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
214	        // Focus/Blur always pass through regardless of disabled/readonly.
215	        match event {
216	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
217	                let ik = *is_keyboard;
218	                return Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
219	                    ctx.focused = true;
220	                    ctx.focus_visible = ik;
221	                }));
222	            }
223	            Event::Blur => {
224	                return Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
225	                    ctx.focused = false;
226	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
227	                }));
228	            }
229	            _ => {}
230	        }
231	
232	        // Disabled blocks all value-changing events.
233	        if ctx.disabled {
234	            return None;
235	        }
236	
237	        // Readonly blocks drag and value adjustments.
238	        if ctx.readonly {
239	            return None;
240	        }
241	
242	        match (state, event) {
243	            (State::Idle, Event::DragStart { position }) => {
244	                let pos = *position;
245	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Dragging).apply(move |ctx| {
246	                    apply_wheel_angle(ctx, pos);
247	                }))
248	            }
249	
250	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragMove { position }) => {
251	                let pos = *position;
252	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
253	                    apply_wheel_angle(ctx, pos);
254	                }))
255	            }
256	
257	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragEnd) => {
258	                let final_color = ctx.value.get().clone();
259	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
260	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("on-change-end", move |_ctx, props, _send| {
261	                        if let Some(ref cb) = props.on_change_end {
262	                            cb.call(final_color);
263	                        }
264	                        no_cleanup()
265	                    })))
266	            }
267	
268	            (_, Event::Increment { step }) => {
269	                let s = *step;
270	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
271	                    let hue = ctx.value.get().hue;
272	                    let new_hue = (hue + s) % 360.0;
273	                    let color = ctx.value.get().clone();
274	                    ctx.value.set(ColorValue { hue: new_hue, ..color });
275	                }))
276	            }
277	
278	            (_, Event::Decrement { step }) => {
279	                let s = *step;
280	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
281	                    let hue = ctx.value.get().hue;
282	                    let new_hue = (hue - s + 360.0) % 360.0;
283	                    let color = ctx.value.get().clone();
284	                    ctx.value.set(ColorValue { hue: new_hue, ..color });
285	                }))
286	            }
287	
288	            (_, Event::SetToMin) => {
289	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
290	                    let color = ctx.value.get().clone();
291	                    ctx.value.set(ColorValue { hue: 0.0, ..color });
292	                }))
293	            }
294	
295	            (_, Event::SetToMax) => {
296	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
297	                    let color = ctx.value.get().clone();
298	                    ctx.value.set(ColorValue { hue: 360.0, ..color });
299	                }))
300	            }
301	
302	            _ => None,
303	        }
304	    }
305	
306	    fn connect<'a>(
307	        state: &'a Self::State,
308	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
309	        props: &'a Self::Props,
310	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
311	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
312	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
313	    }
314	}

320	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
321	#[scope = "color-wheel"]
322	pub enum Part {
323	    Root,
324	    Track,
325	    Thumb,
326	    HiddenInput,
327	}
328	
329	pub struct Api<'a> {
330	    state: &'a State,
331	    ctx: &'a Context,
332	    props: &'a Props,
333	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
334	}
335	
336	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
337	    pub fn is_dragging(&self) -> bool { matches!(self.state, State::Dragging) }
338	    pub fn value(&self) -> &ColorValue { self.ctx.value.get() }
339	
340	    /// Current hue formatted for display.
341	    pub fn formatted_value(&self) -> String {
342	        (self.ctx.messages.value_text)(self.ctx.value.get().hue, &self.ctx.locale)
343	    }
344	
345	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
346	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
347	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
348	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
349	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
350	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.id());
351	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "group");
352	        if self.ctx.disabled { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true); }
353	        if self.ctx.readonly { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-readonly"), true); }
354	        if self.is_dragging() { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-dragging"), true); }
355	        attrs
356	    }
357	
358	    pub fn track_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
359	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
360	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Track.data_attrs();
361	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
362	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
363	        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::Custom("ars-color-wheel-track-bg"),
364	            "conic-gradient(hsl(0,100%,50%), hsl(60,100%,50%), hsl(120,100%,50%), \
365	             hsl(180,100%,50%), hsl(240,100%,50%), hsl(300,100%,50%), hsl(360,100%,50%))");
366	        attrs
367	    }
368	
369	    pub fn thumb_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
370	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
371	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Thumb.data_attrs();
372	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
373	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
374	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("thumb"));
375	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "slider");
376	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "0");
377	
378	        let hue = self.ctx.value.get().hue;
379	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueNow), format!("{:.0}", hue));
380	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMin), "0");
381	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMax), "360");
382	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), (self.ctx.messages.label)(&self.ctx.locale));
383	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueText), self.formatted_value());
384	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy), self.ctx.ids.part("label"));
385	
386	        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::Custom("ars-color-wheel-thumb-angle"),
387	            format!("{}deg", hue));
388	
389	        if self.ctx.focus_visible { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true); }
390	        if self.is_dragging() { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-dragging"), true); }
391	        attrs
392	    }
393	
394	    pub fn hidden_input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
395	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
396	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::HiddenInput.data_attrs();
397	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
398	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
399	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden");
400	        if let Some(ref name) = self.props.name {
401	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name);
402	        }
403	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, self.ctx.value.get().to_hex(true));
404	        attrs
405	    }
406	
407	    pub fn on_thumb_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData, shift: bool) {
408	        let step = if shift { self.ctx.large_step } else { self.ctx.step };
409	        match data.key {
410	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::ArrowUp =>
411	                (self.send)(Event::Increment { step }),
412	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft | KeyboardKey::ArrowDown =>
413	                (self.send)(Event::Decrement { step }),
414	            KeyboardKey::Home => (self.send)(Event::SetToMin),
415	            KeyboardKey::End => (self.send)(Event::SetToMax),
416	            KeyboardKey::PageUp =>
417	                (self.send)(Event::Increment { step: self.ctx.large_step }),
418	            KeyboardKey::PageDown =>
419	                (self.send)(Event::Decrement { step: self.ctx.large_step }),
420	            _ => {}
421	        }
422	    }
423	
424	    pub fn on_track_pointer_down(&self, angle: f64) {
425	        (self.send)(Event::DragStart { position: angle });
426	    }
427	}
428	
429	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
430	    type Part = Part;
431	
432	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
433	        match part {
434	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
435	            Part::Track => self.track_attrs(),
436	            Part::Thumb => self.thumb_attrs(),
437	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
438	        }
439	    }
440	}

158	### 1.5 Full Machine Implementation

161	use ars_core::{TransitionPlan, ComponentIds, AttrMap, Bindable};
162	
163	/// Compute angle from pointer position relative to the center of the track.
164	/// Returns degrees with 0 degrees at the top (12 o'clock), increasing clockwise.
165	fn compute_angle(center: (f64, f64), pointer: (f64, f64)) -> f64 {
166	    let dx = pointer.0 - center.0;
167	    let dy = pointer.1 - center.1;
168	    let radians = dy.atan2(dx);
169	    let degrees = radians.to_degrees();
170	    // Normalize to 0..360, with 0 at top (12 o'clock)
171	    (degrees + 90.0).rem_euclid(360.0)
172	}
173	
174	/// Snap an angle to the nearest step.
175	fn snap_to_step(angle: f64, step: f64) -> f64 {
176	    (angle / step).round() * step
177	}
178

179	/// Wrap a value into the range [min, max).
180	fn wrap_value(value: f64, min: f64, max: f64) -> f64 {

188	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
189	    type State = State;
190	    type Event = Event;

196	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
197	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
198	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
199	        let messages = messages.clone();
200	        let value = match props.value {
201	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v),
202	            None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value),
203	        };
204	
205	        (State::Idle, Context {
206	            value,
207	            step: props.step,
208	            min: props.min,
209	            max: props.max,
210	            disabled: props.disabled,
211	            readonly: props.readonly,
212	            focused: false,
213	            focus_visible: false,
214	            locale,
215	            messages,
216	            ids,
217	        })
218	    }
219	
220	    fn transition(
221	        state: &Self::State,
222	        event: &Self::Event,
223	        ctx: &Self::Context,
224	        _props: &Self::Props,
225	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
226	        // Disabled blocks all except Focus/Blur.
227	        if ctx.disabled {
228	            match event {
229	                Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
230	                    let ik = *is_keyboard;
231	                    return Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
232	                        ctx.focused = true;
233	                        ctx.focus_visible = ik;
234	                    }));
235	                }
236	                Event::Blur => {
237	                    return Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx| {
238	                        ctx.focused = false;
239	                        ctx.focus_visible = false;
240	                    }));
241	                }
242	                _ => return None,
243	            }
244	        }
245	
246	        // Readonly blocks drag and value changes.
247	        if ctx.readonly {
248	            match event {
249	                Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
250	                    let ik = *is_keyboard;
251	                    return Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
252	                        ctx.focused = true;
253	                        ctx.focus_visible = ik;
254	                    }));
255	                }
256	                Event::Blur => {
257	                    return Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx| {
258	                        ctx.focused = false;
259	                        ctx.focus_visible = false;
260	                    }));
261	                }
262	                _ => return None,
263	            }
264	        }
265	
266	        match (state, event) {
267	            // Drag lifecycle
268	            (State::Idle | State::Focused, Event::DragStart { angle }) => {
269	                let snapped = snap_to_step(*angle, ctx.step).clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max);
270	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Dragging).apply(move |ctx| {
271	                    ctx.value.set(snapped);
272	                }))
273	            }
274	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragMove { angle }) => {
275	                let snapped = snap_to_step(*angle, ctx.step).clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max);
276	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
277	                    ctx.value.set(snapped);
278	                }))
279	            }
280	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragEnd) => {
281	                let final_value = *ctx.value.get();
282	                let next_state = if ctx.focused { State::Focused } else { State::Idle };
283	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(next_state)
284	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("on-change-end", move |_ctx, props, _send| {
285	                        if let Some(ref cb) = props.on_change_end {
286	                            cb.call(final_value);
287	                        }
288	                        no_cleanup()
289	                    })))
290	            }
291	
292	            // Focus lifecycle
293	            (_, Event::Focus { is_keyboard }) => {
294	                let ik = *is_keyboard;
295	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
296	                    ctx.focused = true;
297	                    ctx.focus_visible = ik;
298	                }))
299	            }
300	            (_, Event::Blur) => {
301	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx| {
302	                    ctx.focused = false;
303	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
304	                }))
305	            }
306	
307	            // Value adjustments
308	            (_, Event::Increment) => {
309	                let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() + ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max);
310	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
311	                    ctx.value.set(new_val);
312	                }))
313	            }
314	            (_, Event::Decrement) => {
315	                let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() - ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max);
316	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
317	                    ctx.value.set(new_val);
318	                }))
319	            }
320	            (_, Event::SetValue { angle }) => {
321	                let clamped = angle.clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max);
322	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
323	                    ctx.value.set(clamped);
324	                }))
325	            }
326	
327	            // Keyboard
328	            (State::Focused, Event::KeyDown { key }) => {
329	                match key {
330	                    KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => {
331	                        let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() + ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max);
332	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
333	                            ctx.value.set(new_val);
334	                        }))
335	                    }
336	                    KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft | KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => {
337	                        let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() - ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max);
338	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
339	                            ctx.value.set(new_val);
340	                        }))
341	                    }
342	                    KeyboardKey::Home => {
343	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
344	                            ctx.value.set(ctx.min);
345	                        }))
346	                    }
347	                    KeyboardKey::End => {
348	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
349	                            ctx.value.set(ctx.max);
350	                        }))
351	                    }
352	                    KeyboardKey::PageUp => {
353	                        let large_step = ctx.step * 10.0;
354	                        let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() + large_step, ctx.min, ctx.max);
355	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
356	                            ctx.value.set(new_val);
357	                        }))
358	                    }
359	                    KeyboardKey::PageDown => {
360	                        let large_step = ctx.step * 10.0;
361	                        let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() - large_step, ctx.min, ctx.max);
362	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
363	                            ctx.value.set(new_val);
364	                        }))
365	                    }
366	                    _ => None,
367	                }
368	            }
369	
370	            _ => None,
371	        }
372	    }

  "content": "//! `AngleSlider` component state machine and connect API.\n//!\n//! `AngleSlider` is a circular angle input over a bare `f64` value in degrees\n//! (not a [`ColorValue`](ars_core::ColorValue)). It owns the angle math\n//! (snapping, wrapping), value state, keyboard behavior, and ARIA/data\n//! attributes. Live track measurement and pointer capture are adapter concerns;\n//! the adapter converts pointer coordinates to an angle with [`compute_angle`]\n//! and feeds it via [`Api::on_track_pointer_down`] (drag start), then drives\n//! [`Event::DragMove`] / [`Event::DragEnd`] from its own pointer listeners.\n//! Angular direction is universal, so arrow keys are not mirrored for RTL.\n\nuse alloc::{\n    format,\n    string::{String, ToString},\n    vec,\n    vec::Vec,\n};\nuse core::{\n    fmt::{self, Debug},\n    hash::{Hash, Hasher},\n};\n\nuse ars_core::{\n    AriaAttr, AttrMap, Bindable, Callback, ComponentIds, ComponentMessages, ComponentPart,\n    ConnectApi, CssProperty, Env, HtmlAttr, KeyboardKey, Locale, MessageFn, PendingEffect,\n    TransitionPlan, no_cleanup,\n};\n\n/// Formats the angle value for `aria-valuetext`.\ntype ValueTextFn = dyn Fn(f64, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync;\n/// Accessible label for the slider.\ntype LabelFn = dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync;\n/// Consumer callback fired on drag-end / pointer release.\ntype ChangeEndFn = dyn Fn(f64) + Send + Sync;\n\n/// Compute an angle from a pointer position relative to the center of the track.\n///\n/// Returns degrees with `0` at the top (12 o'clock), increasing clockwise. This\n/// is a pure helper for adapters to convert pointer coordinates before calling\n/// [`Api::on_track_pointer_down`].\n#[must_use]\npub fn compute_angle(center: (f64, f64), pointer: (f64, f64)) -> f64 {\n    let dx = pointer.0 - center.0;\n    let dy = pointer.1 - center.1;\n    let degrees = dy.atan2(dx).to_degrees();\n    // Normalize to 0..360, with 0 at the top (12 o'clock).\n    (degrees + 90.0).rem_euclid(360.0)\n}\n\n/// Snap an angle to the nearest multiple of `step`.\nfn snap_to_step(angle: f64, step: f64) -> f64 {\n    if step <= 0.0 || !step.is_finite() {\n        return angle;\n    }\n    (angle / step).round() * step\n}\n\n/// Wrap a value into the range `[min, max)`.\nfn wrap_value(value: f64, min: f64, max: f64) -> f64 {\n    let range = max - min;\n    if range <= 0.0 {\n        return min;\n    }\n    (value - min).rem_euclid(range) + min\n}\n\n/// The states for the `AngleSlider` component.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum State {\n    /// No interaction in progress and not focused.\n    Idle,\n    /// The user is dragging the thumb.\n    Dragging,\n    /// The thumb is focused for keyboard interaction.\n    Focused,\n}\n\n/// The events for the `AngleSlider` component.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub enum Event {\n    /// Pointer down on the track or thumb. Angle in degrees (0-360).\n    DragStart {\n        /// The angle in degrees (0-360).\n        angle: f64,\n    },\n    /// Pointer move during drag. Angle in degrees (0-360).\n    DragMove {\n        /// The angle in degrees (0-360).\n        angle: f64,\n    },\n    /// Pointer released.\n    DragEnd,\n    /// Increase the value by `step`.\n    Increment,\n    /// Decrease the value by `step`.\n    Decrement,\n    /// Set the value to a specific angle.\n    SetValue {\n        /// The angle in degrees (0-360).\n        angle: f64,\n    },\n    /// Focus received.\n    Focus {\n        /// Whether the focus was initiated by a keyboard.\n        is_keyboard: bool,\n    },\n    /// Focus lost.\n    Blur,\n    /// A keyboard key was pressed on the focused thumb.\n    KeyDown {\n        /// The key that was pressed.\n        key: KeyboardKey,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Typed identifier for side effects emitted by the `AngleSlider` machine.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Effect {\n    /// Invoke `Props::on_change_end`.\n    ChangeEnd,\n}\n\n/// The context for the `AngleSlider` component.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub struct Context {\n    /// Current angle value (`0.0`-`360.0` by default).\n    pub value: Bindable<f64>,\n    /// Step size for keyboard increments.\n    pub step: f64,\n    /// Minimum angle value.\n    pub min: f64,\n    /// Maximum angle value.\n    pub max: f64,\n    /// Whether the component is disabled.\n    pub disabled: bool,\n    /// Whether the component is read-only.\n    pub readonly: bool,\n    /// Whether the component is focused.\n    pub focused: bool,\n    /// Whether focus was received via keyboard.\n    pub focus_visible: bool,\n    /// Locale for internationalized messages.\n    pub locale: Locale,\n    /// Resolved translatable messages.\n    pub messages: Messages,\n    /// Component instance IDs.\n    pub ids: ComponentIds,\n}\n\n/// The props for the `AngleSlider` component.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, ars_core::HasId)]\npub struct Props {\n    /// Component instance ID.\n    pub id: String,\n    /// Controlled value. When `Some`, the component is controlled.\n    pub value: Option<f64>,\n    /// Default value for uncontrolled mode.\n    pub default_value: f64,\n    /// Step size for keyboard increments.\n    pub step: f64,\n    /// Minimum angle value.\n    pub min: f64,\n    /// Maximum angle value.\n    pub max: f64,\n    /// Whether the component is disabled.\n    pub disabled: bool,\n    /// Whether the component is read-only.\n    pub readonly: bool,\n    /// The name for form submission.\n    pub name: Option<String>,\n    /// The ID of the form element the component is associated with.\n    pub form: Option<String>,\n    /// Fired on `Event::DragEnd` / pointer release.\n    pub on_change_end: Option<Callback<ChangeEndFn>>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Props {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            id: String::new(),\n            value: None,\n            default_value: 0.0,\n            step: 1.0,\n            min: 0.0,\n            max: 360.0,\n            disabled: false,\n            readonly: false,\n            name: None,\n            form: None,\n            on_change_end: None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// The messages for the `AngleSlider` component.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\npub struct Messages {\n    /// Value text formatter. Receives the current angle. Default: `\"{v} degrees\"`.\n    pub value_text: MessageFn<ValueTextFn>,\n    /// Accessible label for the slider. Default: `\"Angle\"`.\n    pub label: MessageFn<LabelFn>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Messages {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            value_text: MessageFn::new(|v: f64, _locale: &Locale| format!(\"{} degrees\", v as i32)),\n            label: MessageFn::static_str(\"Angle\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ComponentMessages for Messages {}\n\n/// Build the change-end effect that invokes `Props::on_change_end`.\nfn change_end_effect() -> PendingEffect<Machine> {\n    PendingEffect::new(Effect::ChangeEnd, |ctx: &Context, props: &Props, _send| {\n        if let Some(callback) = &props.on_change_end {\n            callback(ctx.value.get());\n        }\n        no_cleanup()\n    })\n}\n\n/// The machine for the `AngleSlider` component.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct Machine;\n\nimpl ars_core::Machine for Machine {\n    type State = State;\n    type Event = Event;\n    type Context = Context;\n    type Props = Props;\n    type Messages = Messages;\n    type Effect = Effect;\n    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;\n\n    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {\n        let value = match props.value {\n            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v),\n            None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value),\n        };\n\n        let context = Context {\n            value,\n            step: props.step,\n            min: props.min,\n            max: props.max,\n            disabled: props.disabled,\n            readonly: props.readonly,\n            focused: false,\n            focus_visible: false,\n            locale: env.locale.clone(),\n            messages: messages.clone(),\n            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),\n        };\n\n        (State::Idle, context)\n    }\n\n    fn transition(\n        state: &Self::State,\n        event: &Self::Event,\n        ctx: &Self::Context,\n        _props: &Self::Props,\n    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {\n        // Disabled and read-only both allow only focus/blur.\n        if ctx.disabled || ctx.readonly {\n            return match event {\n                Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {\n                    let ik = *is_keyboard;\n                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                        ctx.focused = true;\n                        ctx.focus_visible = ik;\n                    }))\n                }\n                Event::Blur => Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.focused = false;\n                    ctx.focus_visible = false;\n                })),\n                _ => None,\n            };\n        }\n\n        match (state, event) {\n            (State::Idle | State::Focused, Event::DragStart { angle }) => {\n                let snapped = snap_to_step(*angle, ctx.step).clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max);\n                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Dragging).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(snapped);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            (State::Dragging, Event::DragMove { angle }) => {\n                let snapped = snap_to_step(*angle, ctx.step).clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max);\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(snapped);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            (State::Dragging, Event::DragEnd) => {\n                let next_state = if ctx.focused {\n                    State::Focused\n                } else {\n                    State::Idle\n                };\n                Some(TransitionPlan::to(next_state).with_effect(change_end_effect()))\n            }\n\n            (_, Event::Focus { is_keyboard }) => {\n                let ik = *is_keyboard;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.focused = true;\n                    ctx.focus_visible = ik;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            (_, Event::Blur) => Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                ctx.focused = false;\n                ctx.focus_visible = false;\n            })),\n\n            (_, Event::Increment) => {\n                let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() + ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max);\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(new_val);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            (_, Event::Decrement) => {\n                let new_val = wrap_value(ctx.value.get() - ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max);\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(new_val);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            (_, Event::SetValue { angle }) => {\n                let clamped = angle.clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max);\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(clamped);\n                }))\n            }\n\n            (State::Focused, Event::KeyDown { key }) => {\n                let large_step = ctx.step * 10.0;\n                let new_val = match key {\n                    KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => {\n                        wrap_value(ctx.value.get() + ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max)\n                    }\n                    KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft | KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => {\n                        wrap_value(ctx.value.get() - ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max)\n                    }\n                    KeyboardKey::Home => ctx.min,\n                    KeyboardKey::End => ctx.max,\n                    KeyboardKey::PageUp => {\n                        wrap_value(ctx.value.get() + large_step, ctx.min, ctx.max)\n                    }\n 157	### 1.5 Full Machine Implementation
158	
159	```rust
160	/// The machine for the `ColorSwatchPicker` component.
161	pub struct Machine;
162	
163	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
164	    type State = State;
165	    type Event = Event;
166	    type Context = Context;
167	    type Props = Props;
168	    type Messages = Messages;
169	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
170	
171	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
172	        let value = match &props.value {
173	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
174	            None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
175	        };
176	
177	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
178	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
179	        let messages = messages.clone();
180	
181	        (State::Idle, Context {
182	            value,
183	            focused_index: None,
184	            colors: props.colors.clone(),
185	            layout: props.layout,
186	            columns: props.columns,
187	            disabled: props.disabled,
188	            focused: false,
189	            focus_visible: false,
190	            locale,
191	            messages,
192	            ids,
193	        })
194	    }
195	
196	    fn transition(
197	        state: &Self::State,
198	        event: &Self::Event,
199	        ctx: &Self::Context,
200	        _props: &Self::Props,
201	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
202	        if ctx.disabled {
203	            return None;
204	        }
205	
206	        let len = ctx.colors.len();
207	        if len == 0 {
208	            return None;
209	        }
210	
211	        match event {
212	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
213	                let kb = *is_keyboard;
214	
215	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
216	                    ctx.focused = true;
217	                    ctx.focus_visible = kb;
218	                    // Focus the selected item, or the first item.
219	                    if ctx.focused_index.is_none() {
220	                        let selected = ctx.colors.iter().position(|c| c == &ctx.value.get());
221	                        ctx.focused_index = Some(selected.unwrap_or(0));
222	                    }
223	                }))
224	            }
225	
226	            Event::Blur => {
227	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx| {
228	                    ctx.focused = false;
229	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
230	                }))
231	            }
232	
233	            Event::Select { index } => {
234	                let idx = *index;
235	
236	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
237	                    if idx < ctx.colors.len() {
238	                        ctx.value.set(ctx.colors[idx].clone());
239	                        ctx.focused_index = Some(idx);
240	                    }
241	                }))
242	            }
243	
244	            Event::FocusNext => {
245	                if !matches!(state, State::Focused) { return None; }
246	
247	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
248	                    let current = ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0);
249	                    ctx.focused_index = Some((current + 1) % ctx.colors.len());
250	                }))
251	            }
252	
253	            Event::FocusPrev => {
254	                if !matches!(state, State::Focused) { return None; }
255	
256	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
257	                    let current = ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0);
258	                    let len = ctx.colors.len();
259	                    ctx.focused_index = Some((current + len - 1) % len);
260	                }))
261	            }
262	
263	            Event::FocusUp => {
264	                if !matches!(state, State::Focused) { return None; }
265	
266	                if ctx.layout != SwatchPickerLayout::Grid { return None; }
267	
268	                let cols = ctx.columns;
269	
270	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
271	                    let current = ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0);
272	                    let len = ctx.colors.len();
273	                    ctx.focused_index = Some((current + len - cols) % len);
274	                }))
275	            }
276	
277	            Event::FocusDown => {
278	                if !matches!(state, State::Focused) { return None; }
279	
280	                if ctx.layout != SwatchPickerLayout::Grid { return None; }
281	
282	                let cols = ctx.columns;
283	
284	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
285	                    let current = ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0);
286	                    ctx.focused_index = Some((current + cols) % ctx.colors.len());
287	                }))
288	            }
289	
290	            Event::FocusFirst => {
291	                if !matches!(state, State::Focused) { return None; }
292	
293	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
294	                    ctx.focused_index = Some(0);
295	                }))
296	            }
297	
298	            Event::FocusLast => {
299	                if !matches!(state, State::Focused) { return None; }
300	
301	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
302	                    ctx.focused_index = Some(ctx.colors.len() - 1);
303	                }))
304	            }
305	        }
306	    }
307	
308	    fn connect<'a>(
309	        state: &'a Self::State,
310	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
311	        props: &'a Self::Props,
312	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
313	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
314	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
315	    }
316	}
317	```

319	### 1.6 Connect / API
320	
321	```rust
322	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
323	#[scope = "color-swatch-picker"]
324	pub enum Part {
325	    Root,
326	    Item { index: usize },
327	    HiddenInput,
328	}
329	
330	pub struct Api<'a> {
331	    state: &'a State,
332	    ctx: &'a Context,
333	    props: &'a Props,
334	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
335	}
336	
337	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
338	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
339	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
340	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
341	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
342	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
343	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.id());
344	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "listbox");
345	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), (self.ctx.messages.label)(&self.ctx.locale));
346	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"), match self.state {
347	            State::Idle => "idle",
348	            State::Focused => "focused",
349	        });
350	        if self.ctx.disabled {
351	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true");
352	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true);
353	        }
354	        match self.ctx.layout {
355	            SwatchPickerLayout::Stack => {
356	                attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Orientation), "horizontal");
357	            }
358	            SwatchPickerLayout::Grid => {
359	                // Grid: no aria-orientation (2D navigation)
360	            }
361	        }
362	        attrs
363	    }
364	
365	    /// Attributes for the item wrapper at the given index.
366	    pub fn item_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {
367	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
368	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] =
369	            Part::Item { index }.data_attrs();
370	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
371	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
372	        let item_id = self.ctx.ids.item("item", index);
373	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, item_id);
374	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "option");
375	
376	        let is_selected = index < self.ctx.colors.len()
377	            && self.ctx.colors[index] == self.ctx.value.get();
378	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Selected),
379	            if is_selected { "true" } else { "false" });
380	        if is_selected {
381	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-selected"), true);
382	        }
383	
384	        let is_focused = self.ctx.focused_index == Some(index);
385	        // Roving tabindex
386	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, if is_focused { "0" } else { "-1" });
387	        if is_focused {
388	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focused"), true);
389	        }
390	        if is_focused && self.ctx.focus_visible {
391	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true);
392	        }
393	        attrs
394	    }
395	
396	    /// Returns props for the embedded ColorSwatch within each item.
397	    pub fn item_swatch_props(&self, index: usize) -> color_swatch::Props {
398	        let color = if index < self.ctx.colors.len() {
399	            self.ctx.colors[index].clone()
400	        } else {
401	            ColorValue::default()
402	        };
403	        color_swatch::Props {
404	            id: self.ctx.ids.item("swatch", index),
405	            color,
406	            color_name: None,
407	            respect_alpha: true,
408	            messages: color_swatch::ColorSwatchMessages::default(),
409	        }
410	    }
411	
412	    /// Hidden input for form participation.
413	    pub fn hidden_input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
414	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
415	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] =
416	            Part::HiddenInput.data_attrs();
417	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
418	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
419	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden");
420	        if let Some(ref name) = self.props.name {
421	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name);
422	        }
423	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, self.ctx.value.get().to_hex(true));
424	        attrs
425	    }
426	
427	    /// Handle keyboard navigation on the root/items.
428	    pub fn on_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
429	        match data.key {
430	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::ArrowDown
431	                if self.ctx.layout == SwatchPickerLayout::Stack =>
432	            {
433	                (self.send)(Event::FocusNext);
434	            }
435	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft | KeyboardKey::ArrowUp
436	                if self.ctx.layout == SwatchPickerLayout::Stack =>
437	            {
438	                (self.send)(Event::FocusPrev);
439	            }
440	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight if self.ctx.layout == SwatchPickerLayout::Grid => {
441	                (self.send)(Event::FocusNext);
442	            }
443	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft if self.ctx.layout == SwatchPickerLayout::Grid => {
444	                (self.send)(Event::FocusPrev);
445	            }
446	            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown if self.ctx.layout == SwatchPickerLayout::Grid => {
447	                (self.send)(Event::FocusDown);
448	            }
449	            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp if self.ctx.layout == SwatchPickerLayout::Grid => {
450	                (self.send)(Event::FocusUp);
451	            }
452	            KeyboardKey::Home => {
453	                (self.send)(Event::FocusFirst);
454	            }
455	            KeyboardKey::End => {
456	                (self.send)(Event::FocusLast);
457	            }
458	            KeyboardKey::Space | KeyboardKey::Enter => {
459	                if let Some(idx) = self.ctx.focused_index {
460	                    (self.send)(Event::Select { index: idx });
461	                }
462	            }
463	            _ => {}
464	        }
465	    }
466	
467	    /// Handle click on a specific item.
468	    pub fn on_item_click(&self, index: usize) {
469	        (self.send)(Event::Select { index });
470	    }
471	}
472	
473	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
474	    type Part = Part;
475	
476	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
477	        match part {
478	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
479	            Part::Item { index } => self.item_attrs(index),
480	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
481	        }
482	    }
483	}

{\n        if ctx.disabled || ctx.colors.is_empty() {\n            return None;\n        }\n\n        match event {\n            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {\n                let kb = *is_keyboard;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.focused = true;\n                    ctx.focus_visible = kb;\n === common.rs ===
//! Shared configuration for the property-based state-machine tests.
//!
//! Centralises two concerns that every `proptest!` block in this harness
//! cares about:
//!
//! 1. **Case count.** Reads the `PROPTEST_CASES` environment variable so
//!    the nightly `extended-proptest` job (10,000 cases) and local runs
//!    (1,000 cases by default) share one knob.
//! 2. **Failure persistence.** Redirects the `*.proptest-regressions`
//!    seed files to a single per-crate `proptest-regressions/`
//!    directory at the crate root instead of dropping them next to test
//!    sources. Default proptest behaviour clutters the source tree with
//!    a sibling file per test module; this single-file layout is the
//!    same content but lives next to `Cargo.toml` where bookkeeping
//!    files belong. The file is committed (per proptest convention) so
//!    every developer's runs benefit from previously-shrunk failures.
//!
//! Use as `#![proptest_config(super::common::proptest_config())]` inside
//! every `proptest!` block in this harness.

use proptest::test_runner::{Config, FileFailurePersistence};

/// Builds a `ProptestConfig` with the workspace-standard case count and
/// failure-persistence layout.
///
/// The persistence target is a single file at
/// `<crate-root>/proptest-regressions/state-machines.txt` — proptest
/// internally namespaces seeds by test name so multiple modules can
/// safely share one file.
#[must_use]
pub(super) fn proptest_config() -> Config {
    let cases = std::env::var("PROPTEST_CASES")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(1000);

    Config {
        cases,
        failure_persistence: Some(Box::new(FileFailurePersistence::Direct(
            "proptest-regressions/state-machines.txt",
        ))),
        ..Config::default()
    }
}

        (

                    "/avatar.png"

                Just(avatar::ImageSrc::from_safe_url(&SafeUrl::from_static(
                    "https://example.com/avatar.png"

            ]),
            prop::option::of(".*"),

                let mut props = avatar::Props::new()
                    .id("avatar")
                    .fallback_delay(fallback_delay);

                props.src = src;
                props.name = name;

                props
            })
    }
