Map OKLCH lightness to 5 levels: very dark (0-0.2), dark (0.2-0.4),\n    ///    medium/omitted (0.4-0.6), light (0.6-0.8), very light (0.8-1.0).\n    /// 3. Map OKLCH chroma: grayish (0-0.04), moderate/omitted (0.04-0.12),\n    ///    vibrant (>0.12). If lightness > 0.7 and chroma moderate -> \"pale\".\n    /// 4. Map OKLCH hue angle to 13 named hues: red, red-orange, orange,\n    ///    yellow-orange, yellow, yellow-green, green, cyan-green, cyan,\n    ///    cyan-blue, blue, purple, magenta.\n    /// 5. Special-case: near-zero chroma -> \"gray\"/\"white\"/\"black\" by lightness.\n    ///\n    /// Returns parts so i18n can reorder (e.g., English: \"{lightness} {chroma}\n    /// {hue}\", Italian: \"{hue} {chroma} {lightness}\").\n    /// Delegate to locale-aware color naming from Messages/CLDR.\n    pub fn color_name_parts(&self, locale: &Locale, messages: &Messages) -> ColorNameParts {\n        // OKLCH classification to determine lightness_level, saturation_level, hue_bucket\n        // then delegate to messages for localized strings\n        let (lightness_level, saturation_level, hue_bucket) = self.oklch_classify();\n        ColorNameParts {\n            lightness: (messages.lightness_label)(lightness_level),\n            chroma: (messages.saturation_label)(saturation_level),\n            hue: (messages.hue_name)(hue_bucket),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Convenience: format as English-order string \"dark vibrant blue\".\n    /// Joins non-empty parts with spaces.\n    pub fn color_name_en(&self) -> String {\n        // Fallback English-only path for tests and non-localized contexts\n        let parts = self.color_name_parts_en();\n        [parts.lightness.as_str(), parts.chroma.as_str(), parts.hue.as_str()]\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n            .copied()\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \")\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "    /// Returns English color-description parts for accessibility.\n    ///\n    /// The parts are English keys (e.g. lightness `\"dark\"`, chroma `\"vibrant\"`,\n    /// hue `\"blue\"`); a component's `format_name` message maps and reorders them\n    /// per locale (English: `\"{lightness} {chroma} {hue}\"`, Italian:\n    /// `\"{hue} {chroma} {lightness}\"`). Keeping the keys English here decouples\n    /// `ColorValue` from any single component's `Messages`.\n    ///\n    /// Classification runs in OKLCH (perceptually uniform):\n    /// 1. Convert HSL -> sRGB -> OKLab -> OKLCH (Björn Ottosson's transform).\n    /// 2. Lightness -> 5 levels: very dark (0-0.2), dark (0.2-0.4),\n    ///    medium/`\"\"` (0.4-0.6), light (0.6-0.8), very light (>=0.8).\n    /// 3. Chroma: grayish (<0.04), moderate/`\"\"` (0.04-0.12), vibrant (>0.12).\n    ///    Moderate chroma with light lightness reads as \"pale\".\n    /// 4. Hue angle -> 13 named hues: red, red-orange, orange, yellow-orange,\n    ///    yellow, yellow-green, green, cyan-green, cyan, cyan-blue, blue,\n    ///    purple, magenta.\n    /// 5. Near-zero chroma collapses to \"gray\"/\"white\"/\"black\" by lightness.\n    pub fn color_name_parts(&self) -> ColorNameParts {\n        let (lightness, chroma, hue) = self.oklch_classify();\n        ColorNameParts {\n            lightness: lightness.to_string(),\n            chroma: chroma.to_string(),\n            hue: hue.to_string(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Convenience: format as an English-order string such as \"dark vibrant blue\".\n    /// Joins the non-empty parts with single spaces.\n    pub fn color_name_en(&self) -> String {\n        let parts = self.color_name_parts();\n        [parts.lightness.as_str(), parts.chroma.as_str(), parts.hue.as_str()]\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n            .copied()\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \")\n    }\n}"
}

161	use ars_core::{TransitionPlan, ComponentIds, AttrMap, Bindable};
162	
163	/// Compute angle from pointer position relative to the center of the track.
164	/// Returns degrees with 0 degrees at the top (12 o'clock), increasing clockwise.
165	fn compute_angle(center: (f64, f64), pointer: (f64, f64)) -> f64 {
166	    let dx = pointer.0 - center.0;
167	    let dy = pointer.1 - center.1;
168	    let radians = dy.atan2(dx);
169	    let degrees = radians.to_degrees();
170	    // Normalize to 0..360, with 0 at top (12 o'clock)
171	    (degrees + 90.0).rem_euclid(360.0)
172	}
173	
174	/// Snap an angle to the nearest step.
175	fn snap_to_step(angle: f64, step: f64) -> f64 {
176	    (angle / step).round() * step
177	}
178	
179	/// Wrap a value into the range [min, max).
180	fn wrap_value(value: f64, min: f64, max: f64) -> f64 {
181	    let range = max - min;
182	    ((value - min).rem_euclid(range)) + min
183	}

  "new_string": "### 1.6 Connect / API\n\nThe `Marker { value: f64 }` variant carries an `f64`, which is not `Eq`/`Hash`,\nso `Part` cannot use `#[derive(ComponentPart)]` (the trait requires `Eq + Hash`).\nIt hand-rolls `PartialEq`/`Eq`/`Hash` comparing/hashing that field via\n[`f64::to_bits`] and a manual `ComponentPart` impl, matching the `Slider`\nconvention.\n\n```rust,no_check\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\npub enum Part {\n    Root,\n    Control,\n    Track,\n    Range,\n    Thumb,\n    ValueText,\n    MarkerGroup,\n    Marker { value: f64 },\n    HiddenInput,\n}\n\nimpl PartialEq for Part {\n    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {\n        match (self, other) {\n            (Self::Marker { value: a }, Self::Marker { value: b }) => a.to_bits() == b.to_bits(),\n            _ => core::mem::discriminant(self) == core::mem::discriminant(other),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl Eq for Part {}\n// `Hash` hashes the discriminant plus `value.to_bits()` for `Marker`; the\n// manual `ComponentPart` impl provides `scope()`, `name()`, `all()`, `ROOT`."
}

1e-9);\n        assert!((with_channel(&base, ColorChannel::Lightness, 0.2).lightness - 0.2).abs() < 1e-9);\n        // Green/Blue replacement preserves alpha.\n        let g = with_channel(&base, ColorChannel::Green, 10.0);\n        assert_eq!(g.to_rgb().1, 10);\n        assert!((g.alpha - 0.8).abs() < 1e-9);\n        let b = with_channel(&base, ColorChannel::Blue, 200.0);\n        assert_eq!(b.to_rgb().2, 200);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn perceptual_naming_covers_lightness_and_chroma_modifiers() {\n        // A dark vivid color picks up a lightness modifier and \"vibrant\".\n {dark_blue:?}\");\n        // A light pastel reads as light + a hue.\n        let pastel = ColorValue::from_rgb(255, 200, 200).color_name_en();\n        assert!(pastel.contains(\"light\") || pastel.contains(\"pale\"), \"got {pastel:?}\");\n        // Purple/magenta hue buckets.\n        assert!(ColorValue::from_rgb(150, 0, 200).color_name_en().contains(\"purple\"));\n true));\n        assert!(black.passes_wcag_aaa(&bg, false));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn format_color_string_hsb_branch() {\n        let red = ColorValue::from_hsl(0.0, 1.0, 0.5);\n // out-of-bounds -> default color\n        let _val = api.value();\n        let _dbg = alloc::format!(\"{api:?}\");\n\n        // Stack layout focus events.\n        let mut stack = Service::<Machine>::new(\n            Props {\n                id: \"csp\".into(),\n                colors: palette(),\n                layout: SwatchPickerLayout::Stack,\n                ..Props::default()\n            },\n            &Env::default(),\n            &Messages::default(),\n        );\n        drop(stack.send(Event::Focus { is_keyboard: true }));\n        // FocusUp/Down are grid-only: no-ops in stack layout.\n        drop(stack.send(Event::FocusUp));\n        drop(stack.send(Event::FocusDown));\n\n        // Navigation events before focus (Idle) are ignored.\n        let mut idle = Service::<Machine>::new(\n            Props { id: \"csp\".into(), colors: palette(), ..Props::default() },\n            &Env::default(),\n            &Messages::default(),\n        );\n        drop(idle.send(Event::FocusNext));\n        assert_eq!(idle.connect(&|_| {}).focused_index(), None);\n\n        // Keyboard dispatch helpers (stack + grid + select).\n        let cap = core::cell::RefCell::new(vec![]);\n        let send = |e: Event| cap.borrow_mut().push(e);\n        let dapi = stack.connect(&send);\n        dapi.on_keydown(&key(KeyboardKey::ArrowDown)); // stack -> FocusNext\n        dapi.on_keydown(&key(KeyboardKey::ArrowUp)); // stack -> FocusPrev\n        dapi.on_keydown(&key(KeyboardKey::Home));\n        dapi.on_keydown(&key(KeyboardKey::End));\n        dapi.on_keydown(&key(KeyboardKey::Enter));\n        dapi.on_item_click(2);\n        let evs = cap.borrow();\n        assert!(matches!(evs[0], Event::FocusNext));\n        assert!(matches!(evs[1], Event::FocusPrev));\n    }\n}"

40	- **`Machine::initial_effects(state, ctx, props) -> Vec<PendingEffect<Self>>`** is part of the `ars_core::Machine` trait (default impl returns empty). Override on machines that can boot in an active state — Popover, Dialog, Tooltip do. Adapters call `Service::take_initial_effects()` exactly once on first mount; the buffer is captured at construction and survives intervening `send()` calls. See `spec/foundation/01-architecture.md` §2.1.1. (task #246, 2026-04-30)
41	- **`PreventableEvent` removed** from `dialog.rs` and `popover.rs`; both now use the shared `ars_components::utility::dismissable::DismissAttempt<()>`. Method names: `prevent_dismiss()` / `is_prevented()` (NOT `prevent_default` / `is_default_prevented`). `DismissAttempt<E>` derives `Default` for `E: Default`. (task #246, 2026-04-30)
42	- **`EFFECT_FOCUS_INITIAL`** (`popover-focus-initial`) is the popover counterpart of dialog's `EFFECT_FOCUS_INITIAL` + `EFFECT_FOCUS_FIRST_TABBABLE` rolled into one named effect because non-modal popovers do not trap focus. Adapter contract: move focus to first tabbable inside content; fall back to content container. (task #246, 2026-04-30)
43	- **Adapter `use_machine` integration**: both `ars-leptos::use_machine_inner` and `ars-dioxus::use_machine_inner` drain `Service::take_initial_effects()` immediately after wiring the send callback, dispatching them through the same `handle_effects` path as regular `SendResult::pending_effects`. (task #246, 2026-04-30)

The post-implementation audit is complete. Here is the consolidated summary for your review (per workflow step 8 — **no commit/push without your approval**).

## Implementation: tasks #297, #298, #299 — agnostic color core

**Foundation** — `crates/ars-core/src/color.rs` (new flat module, re-exported at crate root): `ColorValue` (HSL+alpha) with all conversions, WCAG contrast utilities, OKLCH perceptual naming, `ColorChannel`/`ColorFormat`/`ColorSpace`/`ColorNameParts`/`DragTarget`, and channel/parse/format helpers. `core_maths` added to ars-core (your approval) for no_std float math.

**8 components** under `crates/ars-components/src/specialized/`: `color_swatch`, `color_field`, `color_area`, `color_slider`, `color_wheel`, `angle_slider`, `color_swatch_picker`.

## Audit — Phase 1 (spec/impl drift)
No behavioral bugs found in the implementation. All drift was documentation/contract-accuracy, landed by reconciling the 8 specs to the implementation (the architectural calls you approved):

| Finding | Resolution |
|---|---|
| `ColorValue` module path `components/color_picker.rs` | Spec → `ars-core/src/color.rs` |
| `color_name_parts(&self, locale, messages)` | Spec → no-arg English-keys form |
| `use_platform_effects()`/`track_pointer_drag` in core (nonexistent) | Spec → adapter-driven drag + typed `Effect::ChangeEnd` |
| missing `type Effect` | Added to all stateful machines (NoEffect / bespoke enum) |

36	/// A color value stored in HSL with alpha. All other formats are computed.
37	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
38	pub struct ColorValue {
39	    /// Hue in degrees [0, 360).

41

52	impl ColorValue {
53	    /// Create a new `ColorValue` from the given hue, saturation, lightness, and alpha.
54	    ///
55	    /// Hue is wrapped into `[0, 360)`; saturation, lightness, and alpha are
56	    /// clamped to `[0.0, 1.0]`.
57	    #[must_use]
58	    pub fn new(hue: f64, saturation: f64, lightness: f64, alpha: f64) -> Self {
59	        debug_assert!(hue.is_finite(), "hue must be finite");
60	        debug_assert!(saturation.is_finite(), "saturation must be finite");
61	        debug_assert!(lightness.is_finite(), "lightness must be finite");
62	        debug_assert!(alpha.is_finite(), "alpha must be finite");
63	
64	        Self {
65	            hue: CoreFloat::rem_euclid(hue, 360.0),
66	            saturation: saturation.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
67	            lightness: lightness.clamp(0.0, 1.0),

81	        let h = self.hue / 360.0;
82	        let s = self.saturation;
83	        let l = self.lightness;
84	        let c = (1.0 - CoreFloat::abs(2.0 * l - 1.0)) * s;
85	        let x = c * (1.0 - CoreFloat::abs((h * 6.0) % 2.0 - 1.0));
86	        let m = l - c / 2.0;

88	            0 => (c, x, 0.0),

91	            3 => (0.0, x, c),
92	            4 => (x, 0.0, c),
93	            _ => (c, 0.0, x),

97	            CoreFloat::round((g1 + m) * 255.0) as u8,
98	            CoreFloat::round((b1 + m) * 255.0) as u8,

148	    /// the HSB-space components in `[0.0, 1.0]`.
149	    #[must_use]
150	    pub fn to_hsb(&self) -> (f64, f64, f64) {
151	        let l = self.lightness;
152	        let s = self.saturation;
153	        let v = l + s * fmin(l, 1.0 - l);
154	        let sv = if v == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { 2.0 * (1.0 - l / v) };

160	    pub fn from_rgb(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8) -> Self {
161	        let r = f64::from(r) / 255.0;
162	        let g = f64::from(g) / 255.0;
163	        let b = f64::from(b) / 255.0;
164	        let max = fmax(fmax(r, g), b);
165	        let min = fmin(fmin(r, g), b);
166	        let l = (max + min) / 2.0;
167	        if max == min {
168	            return Self::new(0.0, 0.0, l, 1.0);
169	        }
170	        let d = max - min;
171	        let s = if l > 0.5 {
172	            d / (2.0 - max - min)
173	        } else {
174	            d / (max + min)
175	        };
176	        let h = if max == r {
177	            ((g - b) / d + if g < b { 6.0 } else { 0.0 }) * 60.0
178	        } else if max == g {
179	            ((b - r) / d + 2.0) * 60.0
180	        } else {
181	            ((r - g) / d + 4.0) * 60.0
182	        };
183	        Self::new(h, s, l, 1.0)
184	    }

192	        let hex = hex.trim_start_matches('#');
193	        match hex.len() {
194	            6 => {
195	                let r = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[0..2], 16).ok()?;
196	                let g = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[2..4], 16).ok()?;
197	                let b = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[4..6], 16).ok()?;

199	            }
200	            8 => {
201	                let r = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[0..2], 16).ok()?;
202	                let g = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[2..4], 16).ok()?;
203	                let b = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[4..6], 16).ok()?;
204	                let a = u8::from_str_radix(&hex[6..8], 16).ok()?;
205	                let mut color = Self::from_rgb(r, g, b);
206	                color.alpha = f64::from(a) / 255.0;
207	                Some(color)
208	            }
209	            _ => None,
210	        }

227	/// Linearize a single sRGB channel (0-255) per the WCAG 2.1 sRGB definition.
228	fn srgb_to_linear(c: u8) -> f64 {
229	    let c = f64::from(c) / 255.0;
230	    if c <= 0.040_45 {
231	        c / 12.92
232	    } else {
233	        CoreFloat::powf((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4)
234	    }
235	}

238	    /// Compute the relative luminance per the WCAG 2.1 definition.
239	    ///
240	    /// Uses the sRGB linearization formula: if `C <= 0.04045`, `C / 12.92`;
241	    /// else `((C + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4`. Returns a value in `[0.0, 1.0]`.
242	    #[must_use]
243	    pub fn relative_luminance(&self) -> f64 {
244	        let (r, g, b) = self.to_rgb();
245	        0.2126 * srgb_to_linear(r) + 0.7152 * srgb_to_linear(g) + 0.0722 * srgb_to_linear(b)
246	    }

248	    /// Compute the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between two colors.
249	    ///
250	    /// Returns a value in `[1.0, 21.0]`. Higher is more contrast.
251	    #[must_use]
252	    pub fn contrast_ratio(&self, other: &ColorValue) -> f64 {
253	        let l1 = self.relative_luminance();
254	        let l2 = other.relative_luminance();
255	        let (lighter, darker) = if l1 > l2 { (l1, l2) } else { (l2, l1) };
256	        (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05)
257	    }

601	
602	/// Strip a functional notation call: `name(...)` -> inner content.
603	fn strip_fn_call<'a>(input: &'a str, name: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
604	    let stripped = input.strip_prefix(name)?;
605	    let stripped = stripped.strip_prefix('(')?.strip_suffix(')')?;
606	    Some(stripped)
607	}
608	
609	/// Parse `r, g, b` or `r, g, b, a` inside `rgb()` / `rgba()`.
610	fn parse_rgb_args(inner: &str, has_alpha: bool) -> Option<ColorValue> {
611	    let parts: Vec<&str> = inner.split(',').map(str::trim).collect();
612	    if has_alpha && parts.len() != 4 {
613	        return None;
614	    }
615	    if !has_alpha && parts.len() != 3 {
616	        return None;
617	    }
618	    let r: u8 = parts[0].parse().ok()?;
619	    let g: u8 = parts[1].parse().ok()?;
620	    let b: u8 = parts[2].parse().ok()?;
621	    let a: f64 = if has_alpha {
622	        parts[3].parse().ok()?
623	    } else {
624	        1.0
625	    };
626	
627	    let mut c = ColorValue::from_rgb(r, g, b);
628	    c.alpha = a.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
629	    Some(c)
630	}
631	
632	/// Parse `h, s%, l%` or `h, s%, l%, a` inside `hsl()` / `hsla()`.
633	fn parse_hsl_args(inner: &str, has_alpha: bool) -> Option<ColorValue> {
634	    let parts: Vec<&str> = inner.split(',').map(str::trim).collect();
635	    if has_alpha && parts.len() != 4 {
636	        return None;
637	    }
638	    if !has_alpha && parts.len() != 3 {
639	        return None;
640	    }
641	    let h: f64 = parts[0].parse().ok()?;
642	    let s: f64 = parts[1].strip_suffix('%')?.trim().parse::<f64>().ok()? / 100.0;
643	    let l: f64 = parts[2].strip_suffix('%')?.trim().parse::<f64>().ok()? / 100.0;
644	    let a: f64 = if has_alpha {
645	        parts[3].parse().ok()?
646	    } else {
647	        1.0
648	    };
649	
650	    Some(ColorValue::new(h, s, l, a.clamp(0.0, 1.0)))
651	}
652	
653	/// Parse `h, s%, b%` inside `hsb()`.
654	fn parse_hsb_args(inner: &str) -> Option<ColorValue> {
655	    let parts: Vec<&str> = inner.split(',').map(str::trim).collect();
656	    if parts.len() != 3 {
657	        return None;
658	    }
659	    let h: f64 = parts[0].parse().ok()?;
660	    let s: f64 = parts[1].strip_suffix('%')?.trim().parse::<f64>().ok()? / 100.0;
661	    let b: f64 = parts[2].strip_suffix('%')?.trim().parse::<f64>().ok()? / 100.0;
662	    // Convert HSB -> HSL: lightness = b * (1 - s/2).
663	    let l = b * (1.0 - s / 2.0);
664	    let sl = if l > 0.0 && l < 1.0 {
665	        (b - l) / l.min(1.0 - l)
666	    } else {
667	        0.0
668	    };
669	
670	    Some(ColorValue::new(h, sl, l, 1.0))
671	}
672	
673	/// Parse a user-typed string into a [`ColorValue`].
674	///
675	/// Recognizes: `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb(r,g,b)`, `rgba(r,g,b,a)`,
676	/// `hsl(h,s%,l%)`, `hsla(h,s%,l%,a)`, and `hsb(h,s%,b%)`. Returns `None` for
677	/// any unrecognized or malformed input.
678	#[must_use]
679	pub fn parse_color_string(input: &str) -> Option<ColorValue> {
680	    let trimmed = input.trim();
681	    if trimmed.starts_with('#') {
682	        return ColorValue::from_hex(trimmed);
683	    }
684	    if let Some(inner) = strip_fn_call(trimmed, "rgba") {
685	        return parse_rgb_args(inner, true);
686	    }
687	    if let Some(inner) = strip_fn_call(trimmed, "rgb") {
688	        return parse_rgb_args(inner, false);
689	    }
690	    if let Some(inner) = strip_fn_call(trimmed, "hsla") {
691	        return parse_hsl_args(inner, true);
692	    }
693	    if let Some(inner) = strip_fn_call(trimmed, "hsl") {
694	        return parse_hsl_args(inner, false);
695	    }
696	    if let Some(inner) = strip_fn_call(trimmed, "hsb") {
697	        return parse_hsb_args(inner);
698	    }
699	    None
700	}

702	/// Format a [`ColorValue`] as a string in the given format.
703	#[must_use]
704	pub fn format_color_string(color: &ColorValue, format: ColorFormat) -> String {
705	    match format {
706	        ColorFormat::Hex => color.to_hex(color.alpha < 1.0),
707	        ColorFormat::Rgb => {
708	            let (r, g, b) = color.to_rgb();
709	            if color.alpha < 1.0 {
710	                format!("rgba({}, {}, {}, {:.2})", r, g, b, color.alpha)
711	            } else {
712	                format!("rgb({r}, {g}, {b})")
713	            }
714	        }
715	        ColorFormat::Hsl => color.to_css_hsl(),
716	        ColorFormat::Hsb => {
717	            let (h, s, b) = color.to_hsb();
718	            format!("hsb({:.0}, {:.1}%, {:.1}%)", h, s * 100.0, b * 100.0)
719	        }
720	    }
721	}

        });

Done. All single-letter variables in the new color code are now descriptive names, verified green.

## What changed

**`ars-core/src/color.rs`** — the densest math:
- `to_rgb`: `h/s/l/c/x/m/r1/g1/b1` → `hue_sextant`/`chroma`/`secondary`/`lightness_match`/`red_prime`/…
- `from_rgb`: `max/min/d/s/h` → `max_channel`/`min_channel`/`delta`/`saturation`/`hue`
- `to_oklch`: `lr/lg/lb`, `l/m/s`, `l_/m_/s_`, `a/bb` → `linear_red`, `cone_long/medium/short`, `*_cbrt`, `lab_green_red`/`lab_blue_yellow`
- `color_name_parts`, `to_hsb`, `to_hex`, `from_hex`, `srgb_to_linear`, `hue_name`, parse/format helpers, `fmin`/`fmax`, and all unit tests (`rgb_close(actual, expected, tolerance)`, `let color = …`)

**8 component modules** — `|s|`/`|c|`/`|v|`/`let t`/`let s`/`let c` in production closures and message formatters; test closures `|e: Event|` → `|event: Event|`, `let v`/`let a` → `value`/`swatch`.

**Both proptest files** — strategy/test bindings (`(h,s,l,a)` → `(hue, saturation, lightness, alpha)`, `(rr,gg,bb)` → `(out_red,…)`, loop `|i|` → `|index|`).

I deliberately kept the genuinely-idiomatic short names where a full word wouldn't help and renaming would diverge from the spec: the 2D coordinate `x`/`y` (also the spec-defined `Event::DragStart { x, y }` public fields), and 3-letter abbreviations like `min`/`max`/`ch`/`val`. I recorded the preference in memory for future work.

**Verification (all green):** ars-core lib 24 color tests + 4 proptests; ars-components 71 color + 14 angle + 5 specialized proptests; clippy clean on ars-core (std **and** no_std) and ars-components. Snapshot fixtures are unaffected (renames are internal — no output changed).

> AGENT

Yes — it shouldn't have been discarded. I've replaced all five `let _attrs = …` discards with real connect↔state assertions:

- **ColorSlider / ColorWheel / AngleSlider**: parse the thumb's rendered `aria-valuenow` and assert it tracks the in-range machine value (`[min, max]` / `[0, 360]`). This verifies connect output stays consistent with state across any event sequence — the strongest invariant for these.
- **ColorArea**: assert the thumb exposes a non-empty `aria-valuetext` for every reachable state (it has no single `aria-valuenow`, being a 2D `role="application"`).
- **ColorSwatchPicker**: assert the root renders `role="listbox"` and a `data-ars-state` that's always one of the two declared states (`idle`/`focused`).

These still catch a `connect()` panic on adversarial state (the original intent, documented in the module header) **and** now constrain behavior rather than walking it — matching the audit's "no assertion-free walks" rule. All 5 proptests pass; clippy clean.

The original binding was a deliberate no-panic smoke (the `_attrs` name, vs `let _ =`, only existed to dodge the `let_underscore_drop` lint on `AttrMap`'s destructor) — but you were right that discarding it read as dead code and under-tested the connect surface.

Still at the pre-commit checkpoint. Ready to run `cargo xci-fast` and open the PR whenever you'd like.

  "new_string": "        assert!((ro.connect(&|_| {}).value().unwrap().hue - 10.0).abs() < 1e-9);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn connect_attrs_cover_both_flag_arms() {\n        // All flags ON, channel mode, focused, value + name present.\n        let mut on = service(Props {\n            channel: Some(ColorChannel::Hue),\n            value: Some(ColorValue::from_hsl(180.0, 1.0, 0.5)),\n            disabled: true,\n            readonly: true,\n            invalid: true,\n            required: true,\n            name: Some(\"c\".to_string()),\n            ..Props::default()\n        });\n        drop(on.send(Event::Focus { is_keyboard: true })); // focused + focus_visible\n        let on_api = on.connect(&|_| {});\n        for part in [\n            Part::Root,\n            Part::Label,\n            Part::Input,\n            Part::Description,\n            Part::ErrorMessage,\n            Part::HiddenInput,\n        ] {\n            let _attrs = on_api.part_attrs(part);\n        }\n        // describedby references the error message when invalid.\n        assert!(\n            on_api\n                .input_attrs()\n                .get(&HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy))\n                .is_some()\n        );\n\n        // `has_description` true arm + describedby referencing the description.\n        let mut described = service(Props::default());\n        drop(described.send(Event::SetHasDescription(true)));\n        let described_input = described.connect(&|_| {}).input_attrs();\n        let describedby = described_input\n            .get(&HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy))\n            .expect(\"description is referenced\");\n        assert!(describedby.contains(\"description\"));\n\n        // All flags OFF, whole-color mode, empty value, no name.\n        let off = service(Props::default());\n        let off_api = off.connect(&|_| {});\n        for part in [\n            Part::Root,\n            Part::Label,\n            Part::Input,\n            Part::Description,\n            Part::ErrorMessage,\n            Part::HiddenInput,\n        ] {\n            let _attrs = off_api.part_attrs(part);\n        }\n        // Empty describedby is not emitted.\n        assert!(\n            !off_api\n                .input_attrs()\n                .contains(&HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy))\n        );\n        // Whole-color hidden input without a name omits the name attribute.\n        assert!(!off_api.hidden_input_attrs().contains(&HtmlAttr::Name));\n    }\n}"
}

        id: wasm-bindgen-version
        run: |
          version="$(

684	/// Parse `r, g, b` or `r, g, b, a` inside `rgb()` / `rgba()`.
685	fn parse_rgb_args(inner: &str, has_alpha: bool) -> Option<ColorValue> {
686	    let parts = inner.split(',').map(str::trim).collect::<Vec<_>>();
687	
688	    if has_alpha && parts.len() != 4 {
689	        return None;
690	    }
691	
692	    if !has_alpha && parts.len() != 3 {
693	        return None;
694	    }
695	
696	    let red = parts[0].parse::<u8>().ok()?;
697	    let green = parts[1].parse::<u8>().ok()?;
698	    let blue = parts[2].parse::<u8>().ok()?;
699	
700	    let alpha = if has_alpha {
701	        parts[3].parse::<f64>().ok()?
702	    } else {
703	        1.0
704	    };
705	
706	    let mut color = ColorValue::from_rgb(red, green, blue);
707	
708	    color.alpha = alpha.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
709	
710	    Some(color)
711	}
712	
713	/// Parse `h, s%, l%` or `h, s%, l%, a` inside `hsl()` / `hsla()`.
714	fn parse_hsl_args(inner: &str, has_alpha: bool) -> Option<ColorValue> {
715	    let parts = inner.split(',').map(str::trim).collect::<Vec<_>>();
716	
717	    if has_alpha && parts.len() != 4 {
718	        return None;
719	    }
720	
721	    if !has_alpha && parts.len() != 3 {
722	        return None;
723	    }
724	
725	    let hue = parts[0].parse::<f64>().ok()?;
726	    let saturation = parts[1].strip_suffix('%')?.trim().parse::<f64>().ok()? / 100.0;
727	    let lightness = parts[2].strip_suffix('%')?.trim().parse::<f64>().ok()? / 100.0;
728	
729	    let alpha = if has_alpha {
730	        parts[3].parse::<f64>().ok()?
731	    } else {
732	        1.0
733	    };
734	
735	    Some(ColorValue::new(
736	        hue,
737	        saturation,
738	        lightness,
739	        alpha.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
740	    ))
741	}

761	        0.0
762	    };
763	
764	    Some(ColorValue::new(hue, hsl_saturation, lightness, 1.0))

  "new_string": "fn strip_fn_call<'a>(input: &'a str, name: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    input\n        .strip_prefix(name)?\n        .strip_prefix('(')?\n        .strip_suffix(')')\n}\n\n/// Parse a finite `f64`, rejecting `NaN`/`inf`/`-inf`.\n///\n/// `str::parse::<f64>` accepts the IEEE-754 special-value spellings, which would\n/// otherwise flow into [`ColorValue`] components and surface as a debug-build\n/// panic (via the finiteness assertions in [`ColorValue::new`]) or as NaN/inf\n/// leaking into generated styles and ARIA values in release builds.\nfn parse_finite_f64(input: &str) -> Option<f64> {\n    input.parse::<f64>().ok().filter(|value| value.is_finite())\n}"
}

253	/// Format a color value for display in the input.
254	fn format_value(
255	    color: &ColorValue,
256	    channel: Option<ColorChannel>,
257	    color_format: ColorFormat,
258	) -> String {
259	    if let Some(ch) = channel {
260	        let val = channel_value(color, ch);
261	
262	        match ch {
263	            ColorChannel::Hue | ColorChannel::Red | ColorChannel::Green | ColorChannel::Blue => {
264	                format!("{val:.0}")
265	            }
266	            _ => format!("{:.0}", val * 100.0),
267	        }
268	    } else {
269	        format_color_string(color, color_format)
270	    }
271	}
272	
273	/// Parse `input_text` and update `value`; reset `input_text` to the formatted
274	/// value. Sets `invalid` when parsing fails.
275	fn commit_input(ctx: &mut Context) {
276	    if let Some(ch) = ctx.channel {
277	        // Channel mode: parse as f64.
278	        if let Ok(raw) = ctx.input_text.trim().parse::<f64>() {
279	            let (min, max) = channel_range(ch);
280	
281	            let clamped = raw.clamp(min, max);
282	
283	            if let Some(color) = ctx.value.get() {
284	                let new_color = with_channel(color, ch, clamped);
285	
286	                ctx.value.set(Some(new_color));
287	                ctx.input_text = format_value(&new_color, ctx.channel, ctx.color_format);
288	                ctx.invalid = false;
289	            }
290	        } else {
291	            ctx.invalid = true;
292	        }
293	    } else {
294	        // Whole-color mode: parse via parse_color_string.
295	        if ctx.input_text.trim().is_empty() {
296	            ctx.value.set(None);
297	            ctx.invalid = ctx.required;
298	
299	            return;
300	        }
301	
302	        if let Some(color) = parse_color_string(&ctx.input_text) {
303	            ctx.value.set(Some(color));
304	            ctx.input_text = format_color_string(&color, ctx.color_format);
305	            ctx.invalid = false;
306	        } else {
307	            ctx.invalid = true;
308	        }
309	    }
310	}
311	
312	/// Adjust the channel value by `delta` (positive or negative), clamped to range.
313	fn adjust_channel(ctx: &mut Context, delta: f64) {
314	    if let (Some(ch), Some(color)) = (ctx.channel, ctx.value.get()) {
315	        let current = channel_value(color, ch);
316	
317	        let (min, max) = channel_range(ch);
318	
319	        let new_val = (current + delta).clamp(min, max);
320	
321	        let new_color = with_channel(color, ch, new_val);
322	
323	        ctx.value.set(Some(new_color));
324	        ctx.input_text = format_value(&new_color, ctx.channel, ctx.color_format);
325	        ctx.invalid = false;
326	    }
327	}
328	
329	/// Snap the channel to `min` or `max` and refresh the input text.
330	fn snap_channel(ctx: &mut Context, to_max: bool) {
331	    if let (Some(ch), Some(color)) = (ctx.channel, ctx.value.get()) {
332	        let (min, max) = channel_range(ch);
333	
334	        let target = if to_max { max } else { min };
335	
336	        let new_color = with_channel(color, ch, target);
337	
338	        ctx.value.set(Some(new_color));
339	        ctx.input_text = format_value(&new_color, ctx.channel, ctx.color_format);
340	        ctx.invalid = false;
341	    }
342	}
343	
344	/// The machine for the `ColorField` component.
345	#[derive(Debug)]
346	pub struct Machine;
347	
348	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
349	    type State = State;
350	    type Event = Event;
351	    type Context = Context;
352	    type Props = Props;
353	    type Messages = Messages;
354	    type Effect = NoEffect;
355	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
356	
357	    fn init(
358	        props: &Self::Props,
359	        env: &Env,
360	        messages: &Self::Messages,
361	    ) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
362	        let value = if let Some(v) = &props.value {
363	            Bindable::controlled(Some(*v))
364	        } else {
365	            Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value)
366	        };
367	
368	        let step = props
369	            .step
370	            .unwrap_or_else(|| props.channel.map_or(1.0, channel_step_default));
371	
372	        let large_step = props.large_step.unwrap_or(step * 10.0);
373	
374	        let input_text = if let Some(c) = value.get() {
375	            format_value(c, props.channel, props.color_format)
376	        } else {
377	            String::new()
378	        };
379	
380	        let context = Context {
381	            value,
382	            input_text,
383	            channel: props.channel,
384	            color_format: props.color_format,
385	            step,
386	            large_step,
387	            focused: false,
388	            focus_visible: false,
389	            disabled: props.disabled,
390	            readonly: props.readonly,
391	            invalid: props.invalid,
392	            required: props.required,
393	            is_composing: false,
394	            has_description: false,
395	            name: props.name.clone(),
396	            locale: env.locale.clone(),
397	            messages: messages.clone(),
398	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
399	        };
400	
401	        (State::Idle, context)
402	    }
403	
404	    fn transition(
405	        _state: &Self::State,
406	        event: &Self::Event,
407	        ctx: &Self::Context,
408	        _props: &Self::Props,
409	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
410	        // During IME composition, suppress all keyboard shortcuts.
411	        if ctx.is_composing {
412	            return match event {
413	                Event::CompositionEnd => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
414	                    ctx.is_composing = false;
415	                })),
416	
417	                Event::Change(text) => {
418	                    let next_text = text.clone();
419	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
420	                        ctx.input_text = next_text;
421	                    }))
422	                }
423	
424	                _ => None,
425	            };
426	        }
427	
428	        if ctx.disabled {
429	            return match event {
430	                Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
431	                    let kb = *is_keyboard;
432	                    Some(
433	                        TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
434	                            ctx.focused = true;
435	                            ctx.focus_visible = kb;
436	                        }),
437	                    )
438	                }
439	
440	                Event::Blur => Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {
441	                    ctx.focused = false;
442	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
443	                })),
444	
445	                _ => None,
446	            };
447	        }
448	
449	        match event {
450	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
451	                let kb = *is_keyboard;
452	                Some(
453	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
454	                        ctx.focused = true;
455	                        ctx.focus_visible = kb;
456	                    }),
457	                )
458	            }
459	
460	            Event::Blur => Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {
461	                commit_input(ctx);
462	
463	                ctx.focused = false;
464	                ctx.focus_visible = false;
465	            })),
466	
467	            Event::Change(text) => {
468	                let next_text = text.clone();
469	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
470	                    ctx.input_text = next_text;
471	                }))
472	            }
473	
474	            Event::Commit => {
475	                if ctx.readonly {
476	                    return None;
477	                }
478	
479	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
480	                    commit_input(ctx);
481	                }))
482	            }
483	
484	            Event::SetValue(color) => {
485	                let new_value = *color;
486	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
487	                    if !ctx.focused {
488	                        ctx.input_text = format_value(&new_value, ctx.channel, ctx.color_format);
489	                    }
490	
491	                    ctx.value.set(Some(new_value));
492	                    ctx.invalid = false;
493	                }))
494	            }
495	
496	            Event::SetInvalid(inv) => {
497	                let inv = *inv;
498	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
499	                    ctx.invalid = inv;
500	                }))
501	            }
502	
503	            Event::SetHasDescription(has_description) => {
504	                let has_description = *has_description;
505	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
506	                    ctx.has_description = has_description;
507	                }))
508	            }
509	
510	            Event::Increment => {
511	                if ctx.readonly || ctx.channel.is_none() {
512	                    return None;
513	                }
514	
515	                let step = ctx.step;
516	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
517	                    adjust_channel(ctx, step);
518	                }))
519	            }
520	
521	            Event::Decrement => {
522	                if ctx.readonly || ctx.channel.is_none() {
523	                    return None;
524	                }
525	
526	                let step = -ctx.step;
527	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
528	                    adjust_channel(ctx, step);
529	                }))
530	            }
531	
532	            Event::IncrementLarge => {
533	                if ctx.readonly || ctx.channel.is_none() {
534	                    return None;
535	                }
536	
537	                let step = ctx.large_step;
538	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
539	                    adjust_channel(ctx, step);
540	                }))
541	            }
542	
543	            Event::DecrementLarge => {
544	                if ctx.readonly || ctx.channel.is_none() {
545	                    return None;
546	                }
547	
548	                let step = -ctx.large_step;
549	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
550	                    adjust_channel(ctx, step);
551	                }))
552	            }
553	
554	            Event::IncrementToMax => {
555	                if ctx.readonly || ctx.channel.is_none() {
556	                    return None;
557	                }
558	
559	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
560	                    snap_channel(ctx, true);
561	                }))
562	            }
563	
564	            Event::DecrementToMin => {
565	                if ctx.readonly || ctx.channel.is_none() {
566	                    return None;
567	                }
568	
569	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
570	                    snap_channel(ctx, false);
571	                }))
572	            }
573	
574	            Event::CompositionStart => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
575	                ctx.is_composing = true;
576	            })),
577	
578	            Event::CompositionEnd => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
579	                ctx.is_composing = false;
580	            })),
581	        }
582	    }
583	
584	    fn connect<'a>(
585	        state: &'a Self::State,
586	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
587	        _props: &'a Self::Props,
588	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
589	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
590	        Api { state, ctx, send }
591	    }
592	}
593	
594	/// Structural parts exposed by the `ColorField` connect API.
595	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
596	#[scope = "color-field"]
597	pub enum Part {
598	    /// Container with state/validity data attributes.
599	    Root,
600	
601	    /// `<label>` whose `for` points at the input.
602	    Label,
603	
604	    /// The text or spinbutton `<input>`.
605	    Input,
606	
607	    /// Optional helper text referenced by `aria-describedby`.
608	    Description,
609	
610	    /// Error display (`role="alert"`) referenced by `aria-describedby`.
611	    ErrorMessage,
612	
613	    /// `type="hidden"` input that submits the hex value for forms.
614	    HiddenInput,
615	}
616	
617	/// The connect API for the `ColorField` component.
618	pub struct Api<'a> {
619	    state: &'a State,
620	    ctx: &'a Context,
621	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
622	}
623	
624	impl Debug for Api<'_> {
625	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
626	        f.debug_struct("color_field::Api")
627	            .field("state", &self.state)
628	            .field("ctx", &self.ctx)
629	            .finish_non_exhaustive()
630	    }
631	}
632	
633	impl Api<'_> {
634	    /// Whether the component is currently focused.
635	    #[must_use]
636	    pub const fn is_focused(&self) -> bool {
637	        matches!(self.state, State::Focused)
638	    }
639	
640	    /// The current value of the component.
641	    #[must_use]
642	    pub fn value(&self) -> Option<&ColorValue> {
643	        self.ctx.value.get().as_ref()
644	    }
645	
646	    /// The current raw input text of the component.
647	    #[must_use]
648	    pub fn input_text(&self) -> &str {
649	        &self.ctx.input_text
650	    }
651	
652	    /// The attributes for the root element.
653	    #[must_use]
654	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
655	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
656	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
657	
658	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val).set(part_attr, part_val);
659	
660	        if self.ctx.disabled {
661	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true);
662	        }
663	
664	        if self.ctx.readonly {
665	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-readonly"), true);
666	        }
667	
668	        if self.ctx.invalid {
669	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-invalid"), true);
670	        }
671	
672	        if self.ctx.focused {
673	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focused"), true);
674	        }
675	
676	        if self.ctx.focus_visible {
677	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true);
678	        }
679	
680	        attrs
681	    }
682	
683	    /// The attributes for the label element.
684	    #[must_use]
685	    pub fn label_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
686	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
687	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();
688	
689	        attrs
690	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
691	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
692	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("label"))
693	            .set(HtmlAttr::For, self.ctx.ids.part("input"));
694	
695	        attrs
696	    }
697	
698	    /// The attributes for the input element.
699	    #[must_use]
700	    pub fn input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
701	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
702	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Input.data_attrs();
703	
704	        attrs
705	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
706	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
707	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("input"))
708	            .set(HtmlAttr::Type, "text")
709	            .set(HtmlAttr::Value, self.ctx.input_text.clone());
710	
711	        if let Some(ch) = self.ctx.channel {
712	            // Channel mode: numeric spinbutton.
713	            attrs
714	                .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "spinbutton")
715	                .set(HtmlAttr::InputMode, "numeric");
716	
717	            if let Some(color) = self.ctx.value.get() {
718	                let val = channel_value(color, ch);
719	                let (min, max) = channel_range(ch);
720	
721	                attrs
722	                    .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueNow), format!("{val:.2}"))
723	                    .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMin), format!("{min:.2}"))
724	                    .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMax), format!("{max:.2}"))
725	                    .set(
726	                        HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueText),
727	                        (self.ctx.messages.channel_value_text)(ch, val, &self.ctx.locale),
728	                    );
729	            }
730	
731	            attrs.set(
732	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),
733	                (self.ctx.messages.channel_label)(ch, &self.ctx.locale),
734	            );
735	        } else {
736	            // Whole-color mode: standard text input.
737	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::InputMode, "text").set(
738	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),
739	                (self.ctx.messages.color_label)(&self.ctx.locale),
740	            );
741	        }
742	
743	        attrs.set(
744	            HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy),
745	            self.ctx.ids.part("label"),
746	        );
747	
748	        if self.ctx.invalid {
749	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Invalid), "true");
750	        }
751	
752	        if self.ctx.required {
753	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Required), "true");
754	        }
755	
756	        if self.ctx.readonly {
757	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ReadOnly), true);
758	        }
759	
760	        if self.ctx.disabled {
761	            attrs
762	                .set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true)
763	                .set_bool(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), true);
764	        }
765	
766	        // describedby: description + error message
767	        let mut describedby = Vec::new();
768	
769	        if self.ctx.has_description {
770	            describedby.push(self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
771	        }
772	
773	        if self.ctx.invalid {
774	            describedby.push(self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
775	        }
776	
777	        if !describedby.is_empty() {
778	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), describedby.join(" "));
779	        }
780	
781	        attrs
782	    }
783	
784	    /// The attributes for the description element.
785	    #[must_use]
786	    pub fn description_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
787	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
788	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Description.data_attrs();
789	
790	        attrs
791	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
792	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
793	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
794	
795	        attrs
796	    }
797	
798	    /// Returns the error message text shown when color parsing fails.
799	    ///
800	    /// The adapter renders this inside the `ErrorMessage` part.
801	    #[must_use]
802	    pub fn invalid_message(&self) -> String {
803	        (self.ctx.messages.invalid_message)(&self.ctx.locale)
804	    }
805	
806	    /// The attributes for the error message element.
807	    #[must_use]
808	    pub fn error_message_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
809	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
810	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ErrorMessage.data_attrs();
811	
812	        attrs
813	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
814	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
815	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"))
816	            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "alert");
817	
818	        attrs
819	    }
820	
821	    /// The attributes for the hidden input element.
822	    #[must_use]
823	    pub fn hidden_input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
824	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
825	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::HiddenInput.data_attrs();
826	
827	        attrs
828	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
829	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
830	            .set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden");
831	
832	        if let Some(name) = &self.ctx.name {
833	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name.clone());
834	        }
835	
836	        if let Some(color) = self.ctx.value.get() {
837	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, color.to_hex(true));
838	        }
839	
840	        attrs
841	    }
842	
843	    // --- Event dispatch helpers ---
844	
845	    /// Dispatches an input focus event.
846	    pub fn on_input_focus(&self, is_keyboard: bool) {
847	        (self.send)(Event::Focus { is_keyboard });
848	    }
849	
850	    /// Dispatches an input blur event.
851	    pub fn on_input_blur(&self) {
852	        (self.send)(Event::Blur);
853	    }
854	
855	    /// Dispatches a raw text change.
856	    pub fn on_input_change(&self, text: String) {
857	        (self.send)(Event::Change(text));
858	    }
859	
860	    /// Handles a keydown on the input element.
861	    ///
862	    /// Shortcuts are suppressed while an IME composition is in progress.
863	    pub fn on_input_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
864	        if self.ctx.is_composing {
865	            return;
866	        }
867	
868	        let has_channel = self.ctx.channel.is_some();
869	
870	        match data.key {
871	            KeyboardKey::Enter => (self.send)(Event::Commit),
872	            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp if has_channel => (self.send)(Event::Increment),
873	            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown if has_channel => (self.send)(Event::Decrement),
874	            KeyboardKey::PageUp if has_channel => (self.send)(Event::IncrementLarge),
875	            KeyboardKey::PageDown if has_channel => (self.send)(Event::DecrementLarge),
876	            KeyboardKey::Home if has_channel => (self.send)(Event::DecrementToMin),
877	            KeyboardKey::End if has_channel => (self.send)(Event::IncrementToMax),
878	            _ => {}
879	        }
880	    }
881	
882	    /// Dispatches an IME composition-start event.
883	    pub fn on_composition_start(&self) {
884	        (self.send)(Event::CompositionStart);
885	    }
886	
887	    /// Dispatches an IME composition-end event.
888	    pub fn on_composition_end(&self) {
889	        (self.send)(Event::CompositionEnd);
890	    }
891	}

893	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
894	    type Part = Part;
895	
896	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
897	        match part {
898	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
899	            Part::Label => self.label_attrs(),
900	            Part::Input => self.input_attrs(),
901	            Part::Description => self.description_attrs(),
902	            Part::ErrorMessage => self.error_message_attrs(),
903	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
904	        }
905	    }
906	}

1216	    #[test]
1217	    fn exhaustive_events_parts_and_helpers() {
1218	        // Controlled construction in channel mode exercises every event arm.
1219	        let mut svc = service(Props {
1220	            value: Some(ColorValue::from_hsl(120.0, 0.5, 0.5)),
1221	            channel: Some(ColorChannel::Saturation),
1222	            ..Props::default()
1223	        });
1224	
1225	        for ev in [
1226	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard: true },
1227	            Event::Increment,
1228	            Event::Decrement,
1229	            Event::IncrementLarge,
1230	            Event::DecrementLarge,
1231	            Event::IncrementToMax,
1232	            Event::DecrementToMin,
1233	            Event::SetValue(ColorValue::from_hsl(200.0, 0.3, 0.4)),
1234	            Event::SetInvalid(true),
1235	            Event::SetInvalid(false),
1236	            Event::Commit,
1237	            Event::Blur,
1238	        ] {
1239	            drop(svc.send(ev));
1240	        }
1241	
1242	        let api = svc.connect(&|_| {});
1243	
1244	        for p in [
1245	            Part::Root,
1246	            Part::Label,
1247	            Part::Input,
1248	            Part::Description,
1249	            Part::ErrorMessage,
1250	            Part::HiddenInput,
1251	        ] {
1252	            let _attrs = api.part_attrs(p);
1253	        }
1254	
1255	        let _dbg = format!("{api:?}");
1256	        let _focused = api.is_focused();
1257	        let _text = api.input_text().to_string();
1258	
1259	        // Dispatch helpers route to the right events via a capturing closure.
1260	        let cap = core::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
1261	        let send = |event: Event| cap.borrow_mut().push(event);
1262	
1263	        let dapi = svc.connect(&send);
1264	
1265	        dapi.on_input_focus(false);
1266	        dapi.on_input_blur();
1267	        dapi.on_input_change("#abcdef".into());
1268	        dapi.on_composition_start();
1269	        dapi.on_composition_end();
1270	
1271	        let evs = cap.borrow();
1272	
1273	        assert!(matches!(evs[0], Event::Focus { .. }));
1274	        assert!(matches!(evs[1], Event::Blur));
1275	        assert!(matches!(evs[2], Event::Change(_)));
1276	        assert!(matches!(evs[3], Event::CompositionStart));
1277	        assert!(matches!(evs[4], Event::CompositionEnd));
1278	
1279	        // IME-composing branch: only Change / CompositionEnd are processed.
1280	        let mut ime = service(Props::default());
1281	
1282	        drop(ime.send(Event::CompositionStart));
1283	        drop(ime.send(Event::Change("rgb(1,2,3)".into())));
1284	        drop(ime.send(Event::Increment)); // suppressed while composing
1285	        drop(ime.send(Event::CompositionEnd));
1286	
1287	        assert!(!ime.connect(&|_| {}).is_focused());
1288	
1289	        // Readonly blocks Commit and channel adjustments.
1290	        let mut ro = service(Props {
1291	            readonly: true,
1292	            channel: Some(ColorChannel::Hue),
1293	            value: Some(ColorValue::from_hsl(10.0, 1.0, 0.5)),
1294	            ..Props::default()
1295	        });
1296	
1297	        drop(ro.send(Event::Commit));
1298	        drop(ro.send(Event::Increment));
1299	
1300	        assert!((ro.connect(&|_| {}).value().unwrap().hue - 10.0).abs() < 1e-9);

1	//! `ColorSlider` component state machine and connect API.
2	//!
3	//! `ColorSlider` is a 1D slider that edits a single [`ColorChannel`]. It owns
4	//! the channel math, value state, orientation, keyboard behavior, and ARIA/data
5	//! attributes. Live track measurement, pointer capture, and position-to-value
6	//! conversion are adapter concerns: the adapter supplies an already-normalized
7	//! position in `0..=1` via [`Api::on_track_pointer_down`] (drag start) and
8	//! drives [`Event::DragMove`] / [`Event::DragEnd`] from its own pointer
9	//! listeners, exactly as the slider does.

217	/// Apply a normalized position (`0..=1`) to the channel value.
218	fn apply_slider_position(ctx: &mut Context, position: f64) {
219	    let color = *ctx.value.get();
220	
221	    let (min, max) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
222	
223	    let value = min + position.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * (max - min);
224	
225	    ctx.value.set(with_channel(&color, ctx.channel, value));
226	}
227	
228	/// Build the change-end effect that invokes `Props::on_change_end`.
229	fn change_end_effect() -> PendingEffect<Machine> {
230	    PendingEffect::new(Effect::ChangeEnd, |ctx: &Context, props: &Props, _send| {
231	        if let Some(callback) = &props.on_change_end {
232	            callback(*ctx.value.get());
233	        }
234	
235	        no_cleanup()
236	    })
237	}

239	/// The machine for the `ColorSlider` component.
240	#[derive(Debug)]
241	pub struct Machine;
242	
243	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
244	    type State = State;
245	    type Event = Event;
246	    type Context = Context;
247	    type Props = Props;
248	    type Messages = Messages;
249	    type Effect = Effect;
250	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
251	
252	    fn init(
253	        props: &Self::Props,
254	        env: &Env,
255	        messages: &Self::Messages,
256	    ) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
257	        let value = if let Some(v) = &props.value {
258	            Bindable::controlled(*v)
259	        } else {
260	            Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value)
261	        };
262	
263	        let context = Context {
264	            value,
265	            channel: props.channel,
266	            orientation: props.orientation,
267	            disabled: props.disabled,
268	            readonly: props.readonly,
269	            focused: false,
270	            focus_visible: false,
271	            step: props.step,
272	            large_step: props.large_step,
273	            dir: props.dir,
274	            locale: env.locale.clone(),
275	            messages: messages.clone(),
276	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
277	        };
278	
279	        (State::Idle, context)
280	    }
281	
282	    fn transition(
283	        state: &Self::State,
284	        event: &Self::Event,
285	        ctx: &Self::Context,
286	        _props: &Self::Props,
287	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
288	        if ctx.disabled {
289	            return match event {
290	                Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
291	                    let kb = *is_keyboard;
292	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
293	                        ctx.focused = true;
294	                        ctx.focus_visible = kb;
295	                    }))
296	                }
297	
298	                Event::Blur => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
299	                    ctx.focused = false;
300	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
301	                })),
302	
303	                _ => None,
304	            };
305	        }
306	
307	        match (state, event) {
308	            (State::Idle, Event::DragStart { position }) => {
309	                if ctx.readonly {
310	                    return None;
311	                }
312	
313	                let pos = *position;
314	                Some(
315	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Dragging).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
316	                        apply_slider_position(ctx, pos);
317	                    }),
318	                )
319	            }
320	
321	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragMove { position }) => {
322	                let pos = *position;
323	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
324	                    apply_slider_position(ctx, pos);
325	                }))
326	            }
327	
328	            (State::Dragging, Event::DragEnd) => {
329	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).with_effect(change_end_effect()))
330	            }
331	
332	            (_, Event::Increment { step }) => {
333	                if ctx.readonly {
334	                    return None;
335	                }
336	
337	                let step = *step;
338	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
339	                    let color = *ctx.value.get();
340	                    let current = channel_value(&color, ctx.channel);
341	                    let (_, max) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
342	
343	                    ctx.value
344	                        .set(with_channel(&color, ctx.channel, (current + step).min(max)));
345	                }))
346	            }
347	
348	            (_, Event::Decrement { step }) => {
349	                if ctx.readonly {
350	                    return None;
351	                }
352	
353	                let step = *step;
354	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
355	                    let color = *ctx.value.get();
356	                    let current = channel_value(&color, ctx.channel);
357	                    let (min, _) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
358	
359	                    ctx.value
360	                        .set(with_channel(&color, ctx.channel, (current - step).max(min)));
361	                }))
362	            }
363	
364	            (_, Event::SetToMin) => {
365	                if ctx.readonly {
366	                    return None;
367	                }
368	
369	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
370	                    let color = *ctx.value.get();
371	                    let (min, _) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
372	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(&color, ctx.channel, min));
373	                }))
374	            }
375	
376	            (_, Event::SetToMax) => {
377	                if ctx.readonly {
378	                    return None;
379	                }
380	
381	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
382	                    let color = *ctx.value.get();
383	                    let (_, max) = channel_range(ctx.channel);
384	                    ctx.value.set(with_channel(&color, ctx.channel, max));
385	                }))
386	            }
387	
388	            (_, Event::Focus { is_keyboard }) => {
389	                let kb = *is_keyboard;
390	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {
391	                    ctx.focused = true;
392	                    ctx.focus_visible = kb;
393	                }))
394	            }
395	
396	            (_, Event::Blur) => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {
397	                ctx.focused = false;
398	                ctx.focus_visible = false;
399	            })),
400	
401	            _ => None,
402	        }
403	    }
404	
405	    fn connect<'a>(
406	        state: &'a Self::State,
407	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
408	        props: &'a Self::Props,
409	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
410	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
411	        Api {
412	            state,
413	            ctx,
414	            props,
415	            send,
416	        }
417	    }
418	}
419	
420	/// Structural parts exposed by the `ColorSlider` connect API.
421	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
422	#[scope = "color-slider"]
423	pub enum Part {
424	    /// Container with `role="group"`.
425	    Root,
426	
427	    /// `<label>` whose `for` points at the thumb.
428	    Label,
429	
430	    /// Gradient track.
431	    Track,
432	
433	    /// Draggable thumb with `role="slider"`.
434	    Thumb,
435	
436	    /// `<output>` mirroring the value.
437	    Output,
438	
439	    /// `type="hidden"` input that submits the hex value for forms.
440	    HiddenInput,
441	}
442	
443	/// The connect API for the `ColorSlider` component.
444	pub struct Api<'a> {
445	    state: &'a State,
446	    ctx: &'a Context,
447	    props: &'a Props,
448	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
449	}
450	
451	impl Debug for Api<'_> {
452	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
453	        f.debug_struct("color_slider::Api")
454	            .field("state", &self.state)
455	            .field("ctx", &self.ctx)
456	            .finish_non_exhaustive()
457	    }
458	}
459	
460	impl Api<'_> {
461	    /// Whether the thumb is currently being dragged.
462	    #[must_use]
463	    pub const fn is_dragging(&self) -> bool {
464	        matches!(self.state, State::Dragging)
465	    }
466	
467	    /// The current color value.
468	    #[must_use]
469	    pub fn value(&self) -> &ColorValue {
470	        self.ctx.value.get()
471	    }
472	
473	    /// The current channel value formatted for display.
474	    #[must_use]
475	    pub fn formatted_value(&self) -> String {
476	        let color = self.ctx.value.get();
477	
478	        let val = channel_value(color, self.ctx.channel);
479	
480	        match self.ctx.channel {
481	            ColorChannel::Hue => format!("{val:.0}°"),
482	            ColorChannel::Red | ColorChannel::Green | ColorChannel::Blue => format!("{val:.0}"),
483	            _ => format!("{:.0}%", val * 100.0),
484	        }
485	    }
486	
487	    fn orientation_str(&self) -> &'static str {
488	        if self.ctx.orientation == Orientation::Vertical {
489	            "vertical"
490	        } else {
491	            "horizontal"
492	        }
493	    }
494	
495	    /// Attributes for the root element.
496	    #[must_use]
497	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
498	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
499	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
500	
501	        attrs
502	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
503	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
504	            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "group")
505	            .set(
506	                HtmlAttr::Data("ars-channel"),
507	                format!("{:?}", self.ctx.channel).to_lowercase(),
508	            )
509	            .set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-orientation"), self.orientation_str());
510	
511	        if self.ctx.disabled {
512	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true);
513	        }
514	
515	        if self.ctx.readonly {
516	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-readonly"), true);
517	        }
518	
519	        if self.is_dragging() {
520	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-dragging"), true);
521	        }
522	
523	        attrs
524	    }
525	
526	    /// Attributes for the label element.
527	    #[must_use]
528	    pub fn label_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
529	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
530	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();
531	
532	        attrs
533	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
534	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
535	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("label"))
536	            .set(HtmlAttr::For, self.ctx.ids.part("thumb"));
537	
538	        attrs
539	    }
540	
541	    /// Attributes for the gradient track element.
542	    #[must_use]
543	    pub fn track_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
544	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
545	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Track.data_attrs();
546	
547	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val).set(part_attr, part_val);
548	
549	        let color = self.ctx.value.get();
550	
551	        let gradient = match self.ctx.channel {
552	            ColorChannel::Hue => "linear-gradient(to right, \
553	                hsl(0,100%,50%), hsl(60,100%,50%), hsl(120,100%,50%), \
554	                hsl(180,100%,50%), hsl(240,100%,50%), hsl(300,100%,50%), \
555	                hsl(360,100%,50%))"
556	                .to_string(),
557	
558	            ColorChannel::Alpha => format!(
559	                "linear-gradient(to right, transparent, {})",
560	                ColorValue::new(color.hue, color.saturation, color.lightness, 1.0).to_css_hsl()
561	            ),
562	
563	            _ => {
564	                let (min, max) = channel_range(self.ctx.channel);
565	
566	                let start = with_channel(color, self.ctx.channel, min);
567	                let end = with_channel(color, self.ctx.channel, max);
568	
569	                format!(
570	                    "linear-gradient(to right, {}, {})",
571	                    start.to_css_hsl(),
572	                    end.to_css_hsl()
573	                )
574	            }
575	        };
576	
577	        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::Custom("ars-color-slider-track-bg"), gradient);
578	
579	        attrs
580	    }
581	
582	    /// Attributes for the draggable thumb element.
583	    #[must_use]
584	    pub fn thumb_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
585	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
586	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Thumb.data_attrs();
587	
588	        attrs
589	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
590	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
591	            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("thumb"))
592	            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "slider")
593	            .set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "0");
594	
595	        let color = self.ctx.value.get();
596	
597	        let val = channel_value(color, self.ctx.channel);
598	
599	        let (min, max) = channel_range(self.ctx.channel);
600	
601	        attrs
602	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueNow), format!("{val:.2}"))
603	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMin), format!("{min:.2}"))
604	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMax), format!("{max:.2}"))
605	            .set(
606	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Orientation),
607	                self.orientation_str(),
608	            )
609	            .set(
610	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),
611	                (self.ctx.messages.label)(&self.ctx.locale),
612	            )
613	            .set(
614	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueText),
615	                (self.ctx.messages.value_text)(val, &self.ctx.locale),
616	            )
617	            .set(
618	                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy),
619	                self.ctx.ids.part("label"),
620	            );
621	
622	        let pct = if (max - min).abs() > f64::EPSILON {
623	            (val - min) / (max - min) * 100.0
624	        } else {
625	            0.0
626	        };
627	
628	        attrs
629	            .set_style(
630	                CssProperty::Custom("ars-color-slider-thumb-position"),
631	                format!("{pct:.1}%"),
632	            )
633	            .set_style(CssProperty::BackgroundColor, color.to_css_hsl());
634	
635	        if self.is_dragging() {
636	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-dragging"), true);
637	        }
638	
639	        if self.ctx.focus_visible {
640	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true);
641	        }
642	
643	        attrs
644	    }
645	
646	    /// Attributes for the output element.
647	    #[must_use]
648	    pub fn output_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
649	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
650	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Output.data_attrs();
651	
652	        attrs
653	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
654	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
655	            .set(HtmlAttr::For, self.ctx.ids.part("thumb"))
656	            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), "off");
657	
658	        attrs
659	    }
660	
661	    /// Attributes for the hidden form input.
662	    #[must_use]
663	    pub fn hidden_input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
664	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
665	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::HiddenInput.data_attrs();
666	
667	        attrs
668	            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
669	            .set(part_attr, part_val)
670	            .set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden");
671	
672	        if let Some(name) = &self.props.name {
673	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name.clone());
674	        }
675	
676	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, self.ctx.value.get().to_hex(true));
677	
678	        attrs
679	    }
680	
681	    /// Handles a keydown on the thumb. `shift` selects the large step.
682	    ///
683	    /// For a horizontal slider in RTL, the arrow direction is mirrored so
684	    /// `ArrowLeft` increments and `ArrowRight` decrements. Vertical sliders and
685	    /// `PageUp` / `PageDown` / Home / End are direction-independent.
686	    pub fn on_thumb_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData, shift: bool) {
687	        let step = if shift {
688	            self.ctx.large_step
689	        } else {
690	            self.ctx.step
691	        };
692	
693	        let is_rtl_horizontal =
694	            self.ctx.orientation == Orientation::Horizontal && self.ctx.dir == Direction::Rtl;
695	
696	        match data.key {
697	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight | KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => {
698	                let forward = matches!(data.key, KeyboardKey::ArrowRight) ^ is_rtl_horizontal;
699	
700	                (self.send)(if forward {
701	                    Event::Increment { step }
702	                } else {
703	                    Event::Decrement { step }
704	                });
705	            }
706	
707	            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => (self.send)(Event::Increment { step }),
708	
709	            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => (self.send)(Event::Decrement { step }),
710	
711	            KeyboardKey::Home => (self.send)(Event::SetToMin),
712	
713	            KeyboardKey::End => (self.send)(Event::SetToMax),
714	
715	            KeyboardKey::PageUp => (self.send)(Event::Increment {
716	                step: self.ctx.large_step,
717	            }),
718	
719	            KeyboardKey::PageDown => (self.send)(Event::Decrement {
720	                step: self.ctx.large_step,
721	            }),
722	
723	            _ => {}
724	        }
725	    }
726	
727	    /// Dispatches a drag-start from an adapter-resolved normalized position.
728	    pub fn on_track_pointer_down(&self, position: f64) {
729	        (self.send)(Event::DragStart { position });
730	    }
731	}
732	
733	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
734	    type Part = Part;
735	
736	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
737	        match part {
738	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
739	            Part::Label => self.label_attrs(),
740	            Part::Track => self.track_attrs(),
741	            Part::Thumb => self.thumb_attrs(),
742	            Part::Output => self.output_attrs(),
743	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
744	        }
745	    }
746	}

497	pub struct Bindable<T: BindableValue> {
498	    /// The externally controlled value, or `None` if uncontrolled.
499	    controlled: Option<T>,
500	
501	    /// The internal value managed by the component.
502	    internal: T,
503	}
504	
505	impl<T: BindableValue> Bindable<T> {
506	    /// Creates a controlled bindable owned by the parent.
507	    ///
508	    /// Both the controlled and internal fields are initialized to the given value.
509	    /// The component reads the controlled value via [`get`](Self::get).
510	    #[must_use]
511	    pub fn controlled(value: T) -> Self {
512	        Self {
513	            internal: value.clone(),
514	            controlled: Some(value),
515	        }
516	    }
517	
518	    /// Creates an uncontrolled bindable managed by the component.
519	    ///
520	    /// There is no external controlled value; [`get`](Self::get) returns the
521	    /// internal value which can be updated via [`set`](Self::set).
522	    #[must_use]
523	    pub const fn uncontrolled(default: T) -> Self {
524	        Self {
525	            controlled: None,
526	            internal: default,
527	        }
528	    }
529	
530	    /// Returns a reference to the current value.
531	    ///
532	    /// Returns the controlled value if set, otherwise the internal value.
533	    #[must_use]
534	    pub fn get(&self) -> &T {
535	        self.controlled.as_ref().unwrap_or(&self.internal)
536	    }
537	
538	    /// Returns `true` if this value is controlled by the parent.
539	    #[must_use]
540	    pub const fn is_controlled(&self) -> bool {
541	        self.controlled.is_some()
542	    }
543	
544	    /// Updates the internal value.
545	    ///
546	    /// In controlled mode, this becomes the pending internal value that is
547	    /// revealed once the bindable returns to uncontrolled mode.
548	    pub fn set(&mut self, value: T) {
549	        self.internal = value;
550	    }
551	
552	    /// Pushes a new controlled value from the parent.
553	    ///
554	    /// This should be called when the parent's controlled prop changes.
555	    pub fn sync_controlled(&mut self, value: Option<T>) {
556	        self.controlled = value;
557	    }
558	
559	    /// Returns a mutable reference to the internal value.
560	    ///
561	    /// Use for in-place mutations on collection types to avoid cloning.
562	    /// **Warning:** For controlled bindables, mutating the internal value has no
563	    /// effect on what [`get`](Self::get) returns (it returns the controlled value).
564	    pub const fn get_mut_owned(&mut self) -> &mut T {
565	        &mut self.internal
566	    }
567	}
568	
569	impl<T: BindableValue + Default> Default for Bindable<T> {
570	    fn default() -> Self {
571	        Self::uncontrolled(T::default())
572	    }
573	}

616	        [

619	        ]

  "new_string": "    /// Returns a mutable reference to the internal value.\n    ///\n    /// Use for in-place mutations on collection types to avoid cloning.\n    /// **Warning:** For controlled bindables, mutating the internal value has no\n    /// effect on what [`get`](Self::get) returns (it returns the controlled value).\n    pub const fn get_mut_owned(&mut self) -> &mut T {\n        &mut self.internal\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the internal (pending) value, ignoring any controlled override.\n    ///\n    /// Unlike [`get`](Self::get) — which returns the controlled value when the\n    /// bindable is controlled — this always returns the value staged via\n    /// [`set`](Self::set), i.e. the value the component would commit. Use this\n    /// when reporting a just-computed result to the parent (for example the\n    /// final value passed to an `on_change_end` callback at the end of a drag):\n    /// in controlled mode the parent has not yet round-tripped the new value\n    /// back through its prop, so [`get`](Self::get) would still return the stale\n    /// controlled value.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub const fn pending(&self) -> &T {\n        &self.internal\n    }"
}

  "new_string": "    fn on_props_changed(old: &Props, new: &Props) -> Vec<Event> {\n        assert_eq!(\n            old.id, new.id,\n            \"color_slider::Props.id must remain stable after init\"\n        );\n\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        if old.value != new.value {\n            events.push(Event::SyncValue(new.value));\n        }\n\n        if props_output_changed(old, new) {\n            events.push(Event::SetProps);\n        }\n\n        events\n    }\n\n    fn connect<'a>(\n        state: &'a Self::State,\n        ctx: &'a Self::Context,\n        props: &'a Self::Props,\n        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),\n    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {\n        Api {\n            state,\n            ctx,\n            props,\n            send,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Whether any cached output prop changed and the context needs refreshing.\n///\n/// `name` is omitted: it is read live from `Props` in `hidden_input_attrs`\n/// rather than cached in the context, so a name-only change needs no resync.\nfn props_output_changed(old: &Props, new: &Props) -> bool {\n    old.channel != new.channel\n        || old.orientation != new.orientation\n        || (old.step - new.step).abs() > f64::EPSILON\n        || (old.large_step - new.large_step).abs() > f64::EPSILON\n        || old.disabled != new.disabled\n        || old.readonly != new.readonly\n        || old.dir != new.dir\n}"
}
